tei:div.tei:p: "$ (317)༄༅// dpal 'khor lo bde mchog ras chung lugs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bde chen lang tsho zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

(318)༄༅// na mo gu ru shrī dz+wa la sam+ba re bh+yaḥ kun khyab zag med dbyings las mi g.yo bar// ye shes rol pa'i gar mdzad bde ba mchog /'khor lo lnga yi lha la gus btud nas// dkyil 'khor cho ga'i lag len nyung gsal bkod// de'ang bka' srol 'di'i lugs kyi smin lam yid bzhin nor bu la dbang po rab 'bring tha gsum gyi dbang gis sgrub thabs rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum/ smin byed rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gnang*/ re re bzhin sbyang bas smin byed rnam grangs bzhi bcu rtsa grangs 'byung yang rgyas pa'i khongs su bsdus pa shugs kyis 'du ba dang*/ dbang po tha ma la/ phyi dkyil rgyas pa la dbang bskur rgyas pa sbyar na gzhan rnams zhar byung du grub pas de'i dbang du byas na/ rtsa ba'i sdom la/ slob dpon slob ma dgos dus gnas// ji ltar dbang bskur tshul dang drug /ces gsungs pa las/ 'dir ji ltar dbang bskur ba'i tshul bshad/ de yang sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum/ re re la'ang nang tshan dbye ba mang du dbye bar gsungs kyang 'dir rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor mi 'grub pa'i dbang du byas nas/ ras bris kyi phyogs la nges par dgos pa'i lag len mdor bsdus te bkod na/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum/ sngon 'gro la sa chog skabs 'dir mi dgos/ sta gon rnams la 'jug pa'i thog mar sgrub thabs kyi dbu nas brtsams bdag bskyed (319 )bzlas pa bsdu ldang gi bar grub par bya/ de nas sta gon gyi rim pa bzhi'i dang po lha sta gon ni/ mdun tu stegs bu dri bzang gi chus chag chag btab pa'am/ lag len bde ched maṇ+ḍal byi dor byas par slob dpon gyis gtso bo yab yum gyi snying po dang nye snying*/ so so'i sa bon rnams brjod bzhin pas dbus su chang dang dri bzang sbyar ba'i thig le gru bzhi/ de rgyab phyogs bzhir bzhi/ de rgyab phyogs mtshams brgyad rim pa bzhi la thig la brgyad tshan bzhi bcas g.yon pa'i smin mdzub kyis g.yon skor du bkod/

de rnams kyi steng du las rdor gyis gtso bo la tshom bu che gcig /'khor rnams la chung ba re bkod la gzhi stegs su bkod/ mdun du nang mchod thod pa'i bdud rtsi/ mtha' skor du mchod yon dang nyer spyod g.yon skor du bsham/ sgrub thabs ltar mchod pa rnams byin brlab/ tshom bu rnams khaṇ+ḍa ro he sa bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'og gzhir 'byung ba rim brtsegs srung 'khor dang bcas pa'i steng du thar pa chen po'i gzhal med khang rgyan dang bkod pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis bskor ba'i gzhal yas khang gi lte bar pad nyi 'jigs byed dus mtshan gyi gdan/ 'khor lo lnga'i lha rnams la so so'i gdan dang bcas grub par gyur/ (320)dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du hūm̐ mthing nag las rdo rje sngon po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa de las 'od zer 'phros/ rgyal ba sras bcas mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ka 'khor lo sdom pa'i skur gyur pa ni sogs sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba ltar la/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// yab yum bde ba chen por snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang chub sems kyi thig le'i 'od zer phyi rol tu 'phros te 'khor rnams kyi gdan thog tu 'khod pa las bde chen 'khor lo'i phyogs kyi pad 'dab bzhi la sogs nas/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// de rnams kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon pos mtshan par gyur/ 'bar ba'i rgya dang*/ phaiṃ phaiṃ zhes pa nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ 'i bar dang*/ slar yang lha rnams kyi thugs ka'i sa bon sogs nas/ rang rang gi rigs bdag gis dbur brgyan par gyur/ bar sgrub thabs bzhin bya/ de nas 'og gi mdun bskyed skabs ltar phyi mchod mchod yon nyer spyod/

rig ma bcu drug rnams dang*/ nang mchod/ gsang mchod/ de kho na nyid mchod rnams sgrub thabs ltar byas la/ oṃ/ bcom ldan mgon po sogs rkang brgyad kyis bstod/ thal mo sbyar te spos thogs la/ bla ma dang dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ rnal 'byor pa rdo rje che ge mo zhes bgyi ba bdag gis kyang dam pa khyed rnams kyi rjes su zhugs nas 'gro ba ma smin pa rnams smin par bya ba dang*/ ma grol ba rnams sol bar bya ba dang*/ dbugs ma phyung ba rnams dbugs dbyung bar bya ba'i slad du slob ma rnams la dbang bskur ba'i rim pa la 'jug par bgyi na/ thugs brtse ba chen pos nye bar dgongs te bkas gnang ba dang byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ ces gsol ba btab pas dkyil 'khor 'dri ba'i gnang ba thob par mos nas 'degs pa'i rgya dang*/ oṃ badz+ra u d+dīṣ+ṭha/ zhes dkyil 'khor gyi (321)lha rnams nam mkha'i dbyings su bzhugs par mos pa/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+rā ya swā hā/ zhes brjod la maṇ+ḍal bsdu'o// gnyis pa bum pa sta gon la/ rnam rgyal dar sngon po dang las bum dar dmar po'i mgul chings/ gnyis kar dri bzang chus sum gnyis bkang*/ bum rdzas so lnga btab/ gu gul gyis bdug /yungs kar 'thor la sum+bha ni'i sngags brjod la bgegs bskrad/ rnam rgyal dkyil 'khor gyi dbus mañdzi'i stegs dang las bum g.yon ngos su kha rgyan dang bcas te bzhag rnam rgyal gyi khar dung chos dri bzang gi chus bkang ba dang gzungs rdor bkod/ gtor ma dang mchod pa rnams sngar ltar bshams la byin brlab/ bum pa gnyis gong ltar bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ pam̐ las pad+ma dang*/ a a las zla ba'i gdan gnyis kyi steng du/ bh+rūm̐ bh+rūm̐ las rin po che bai ḍūr+ya las grub pa'i bum pa gnyis lto ba yangs shing mgrin pa phra ba/ kha g.yel zhing mchu 'phyang ba/ lha rdzas dar gyis mgul pa dkris shing*/

dpag bsam shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud bzang pos yongs su gang ba'i rnam rgyal bum pa'i nang du 'og gzhi 'khor lo dkar po/ de steng dmar po/ de steng sngon po thams cad kyang rtsibs brgyad pa 'khor lo dang pad+ma dang rdo rje'i phreng bas bskor ba/ de steng pam̐ las pad+ma 'dab brgyad a las zla ba ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du 'jigs byed dus mtshan dang bcas pa/ mtshams bzhir bum thod bdud rtsis gang ba'i khar sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa re/ 'khor lo gsum gyi rtsibs rnams dang sgo mtshams brgyad la pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan re re grub par gyur/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du rdo rje mthing nag hūm̐ sngon pos mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros sogs gong gi lha sta gon ltar/ gtso bo yab yum dang 'khor rnams kyi bskyed chog tshang bar brjod/ las thams cad pa'i bum pa'i nang du/ pam̐ las pad+ma dang*/ ram̐ las nyi ma/ bam̐ las ro'i gdan gyi steng du lha mo khaṇ+ḍā ro he ma sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ g.yas dang po gri gug /gnyis (322)pa na ḍā ma ru/ g.yon dang po thod khrag /gnyis pa na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ khro la 'dzum pa'i zhal mche ba cung zad gtsigs shing mdzes la yangs pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ dbu skra sil bu'i stod cha gyen du brdzes pa nor bu dang me tog gi phreng bas mdzes shing lhag ma thur du grol bas rked pa non pa/ thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ gcer bu rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ gzugs dang lang tsho dar la babs shing bha ga dang nu ma rab tu rgyas pa/ bde ba chen pos rnam par myos pa'i cha byad can gyi zhabs gnyis g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang ba'i gar stabs kyis pad nyi ro'i gdan la bzhugs pa'o// lha thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po sogs gnas gsum byin brlab/ dam ye bsre ba/ dbang bskur/

rgyas gdab rnams lha sta gon ltar bya ba'i tshig mjug don yod grub pas dbur brgyan/ khaṇ+ḍa ro he la rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbur brgyan/ dbang lha rnams kyang dbu rgyan la thim par gyur/ de nas phyi'i mchod pa ni/ bh+rūm̐ oṃ dz+riṃ kham̐ hūm̐ rnams 'od du zhu ba/ lha rdzas las grub pa'i gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya rnams ngo bo bzang zhing rgya che ba bkod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa thogs pa'i lha mo dpag tu med pas bum nang gi lha la mchod par bsams la/ oṃ āḥrū pa badz+ra hūm̐/ de bzhin du/ shab+da/ gan+dhe/ ra sa/ spar+she badz+ra hūm̐/ oṃ bha ga wān shrī he ru ka tsakra sam+ba raṃ wī ra yo gi nī khaṇ+ḍa ro he sa pa ri wā ra pañtsa kā ma gu ṇa pū dza hoḥ nang mchod ni/ bde chen 'khor lo'i mtshams bzhi'i bum thod bdud rtsis gang ba rnams las thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba dpag tu med pa 'phros pas/ lha re re'i phyag tu thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba re re byung ba rnams gsol bas/ lha thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs zag pa med pa'i bdud rtsis tshim par bsam/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ lan gsum/ oṃ bha ga= sa pa ri wā ra a mṛ ta pū dza hoḥ zhes bdud rtsi 'thor zhing 'bul lo// gsang mchod (323) ni/ gtso bo yab yum sku gsung thugs kyi lha rnams snyoms par zhugs pas nang gi mkha' 'gro ma bzhi dang lha mo khaṇ+ḍa ro he phyogs mtshams ma brgyad la sogs te 'khril sbyor med pa rnams kyang ra ro ba'i zag med kyi bde ba myong bar bsams la/ oṃ bha ga= wā ra ma hā su kha gu h+ya pū dza hoḥ zhes 'khyud rgya bya/ de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa ni/ oṃ bha ga= wā ra shun+ya tā dz+nyā na pū dza hoḥ zhes gnas lugs kyi ngang la mnyam par bzhag go / hūm̐/ pad nyi 'jigs byed sogs dang*/ las bum gyi lha la/ dpal ldan rin chen mkha' 'gro ma// mkha' 'gro ma yis 'khor los sgyur// ye shes lnga dang sku gsung thugs// 'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal bstod/

ces pas bstod/ bzlas pa bya ba ni/ gzungs thag la 'jus te/ rang gi thugs ka nas sngags kyi phreng ba gzungs thag la 'khril te bum nang gi lha yi thugs kar thim pas lha tshogs rnams kyi sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar gyur par bsams la/ bzlas pa bya ba ni lha gtso 'khor thams cad kyi thugs srog sngags phreng dang bcas pa man ngag ltar gsal btab la/ oṃ hrīḥha ha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ yab kyi nye snying ngo*// oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru ru kaṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ḍā ki nī dz+wa la saṃ pa raṃ swā hā/ yab kyi snying po'o// oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ yum gyi snying po'o// oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ yum gyi nye snying ngo*// 'di rnams brgya rtsa las mi nyung bar ci 'grub bzla/ mkha' 'gro ma bzhi/ 'khor lo gsum/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad bcas kyi sngags rnams kyang nyer gcig gam bdun re tsam bzla/ gzungs thag las bum la spos te/ oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro he huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ mthar mchod pa kha gso/ gtor ma byin rlabs ni/ oṃ stong pa nyid du gyur/ āḥ rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ hūm̐ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma gzugs dam pa/ sgra dam pa/ dri dam pa/ ro dam pa/ reg bya dam pa/ 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa yul sa dang nam mkha' bar snang (324)thams cad la khyab cing rgyas pa nyid du gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ lan gsum gyis brlab/ rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye ba'i phyag rgyas/ oṃ bha ga wān shri he ru ka tsakra sam+ba raṃ wī ra yo gi nī khaṇ+ḍa ro hi sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan gsum gyis phul la/ bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i lha tshogs rnams kyis bdag cag rnams la thugs brtse ba chen pos dgongs te mchog thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsol ba dang bde chen phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub myur ba nyid du stsal bar mdzad du gsol//

slar yang sgrub thabs ltar mchod rdzas byin brlab/ rab 'byams zhing gi dkyil 'khor thams cad par// rgyal ba'i spyan la mdzes pa ma lus kun// gcig bsdus gzugs kyi rdo rje'i sgyu 'phrul dpyid// bcom ldan bum pa'i lha la 'bul bar bgyi// oṃ bha ga wān shrī he ru ka tsakra sam+ba raṃ wi ra yo gi nī khaṇ+ḍa ro he sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra rū pa pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ rab 'byams zhing gi= rgyal ba'i snyan la 'jebs pa ma lus kun// gcig bsdus sgra yi rdo rje'i sgyu 'phrul dpyid// bcom ldan bum= shab+da pū dza= rab 'byams= rgyal ba'i shangs la zhim pa ma lus kun// gcig bsdus dri yi rdo rje'i sgyu 'phrul dpyid// bcom ldan= gan+dhe pū dza= rab 'byams= rgyal ba'i ljags la bda' ba ma lus kun// gcig bsdus ro yi rdo rje'i sgyu 'phrul dpyid// bcom ldan= ra sa pū dza= rab 'byams= rgyal ba'i sku la bde ba ma lus kun// gcig bsdus reg bya rdo rje'i sgyu 'phrul dpyid// bcom ldan= spar+she pū dza= srab 'jam yang ba lha yi gos// mi bskyod rdo rje'i sku bsnyes la// mi phyed dad pas bdag 'bul na// bdag kyang rdo rje'i sku thob shog /oṃ bha ga wan= badz+ra spar+she pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ de las gzhan yang mchod pa'i tshogs// rol mo dbyangs snyan yid 'ong ldan// (325)sems can sdug bsngal sel mdzad pa'i// sprin rnams so sor gnas gyur cig / ces rol mo bya'o// bstod pa ni/ hūm̐/ bcom ldan mgon po sogs yab yum gyi rkang brgyad dang*/ dpal ldan rin chen mkha' 'gro ma/ sogs kyis bstod/ de nas bdud rtsir bsgyur ba ni/ dung chos kyi mchod yon gtso bo dang las kyi bum par dbul ba dang bcas/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ yig las 'od zer bum nang du 'phros pas/ bum nang gi lha ye shes pa rnams phye ste rang gi snying gar dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ

dam tshig pa 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i bdud rtsi'i nus pa phun sum tshogs pas bum pa gang bar gyur bar bsam mo// slob ma sta gon ni/ smin lam yid bzhin nor bu las rtsa ba'i sdom tshig bco lngar gsungs kyang*/ 'dir mdor bsdus tsam du/ thog mar/ slob ma rnams phyi rol du khrus bya/ nang du 'khod/ maṇ+ḍal bkye bsdu byas la/ ma gyur nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du bde chen phyag rgya chen po dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du zab lam mkha' 'gro snyan brgyud kyi smin byed kyi dbang bskur zhus nas grol byed rim pa gnyis kyi rnal 'byor nyams su blang bar bgyi'o snyam du byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa dang*/ chos gsan pa'i kun spyod rnams tshul bzhin ldan pas gsan par zhu/ 'dir drang nges kyi chos bshad dang brgyud pa yid bzhin nor bu'i lo rgyus rgyas par bshad par gsungs la/ mi nus pas mdor bsdu na/ de'ang rang re rnams rnyed par dka' ba dal ba brgyad 'byor pa bcu dang ldan pa'i mi lus rin po che lha bas lhag pa'i lus rten khyad par can thob/ mjal bar dka' ba'i bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen mtshan nyid dang ldan pa mjal/ thos par dka' ba dam pa'i chos spyi dang khyad par theg pa chen po/ de'i yang snying dus gsum du 'byon par dka' ba gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i zab chos 'di lta bu ni dbul pos yid bzhin gyi nor bu rnyed pa las kyang ngo mtshar (326)shin tu che ba yin kyang*// myur du nyams len la ma 'bad na/ spyir 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag /sgos 'gro ba'i tshe srog nam mkha'i glog dang chu'i chu bur las kyang 'jig sla bas de ring tsam du'ang mi 'chi ba'i nges pa med/ shi ba'i 'og tu rnam bar shes pa las dge sdig gi rjes su 'brang zhing mtho ris dang ngan song du skye/ srid pa'i rtse mo nas na raka dmyal khams yan chad sdug bsngal gsum gyi rang bzhin las ma 'das pas/

'khor ba thog ma med pa nas da lta'i bar du lus grangs med par blangs shing sdug bsngal dpag tu med pa myong*/ da dung yang mtha' med pa'i 'khor bar 'khyams shing sdug bsngal de tsam myong bar 'gyur bas 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho 'di la zhen log dang nges 'byung gi blo drag tu bskyed pa thog mar gal che/ 'khor ba las thar bar byed pa la blo bla ma dkon mchog la gtad cing skyabs su 'gro/ theg dman dang mthun par dge ba'i las bcu bsgrubs pas mtho ris kyi bde ba thob cing de'ang byang chub sems kyis zin na sangs rgyas 'grub pa'i rgyur 'gyur/ mi dge ba bcu spyad na ngan song gi sdug bsngal tshad med pa myong bar 'gyur bas dge ba ci nus su bsgrub/ sdig pa mi dge ba srog la bab kyang spang ba ni dam pa'i chos sgrub pa bya ba yin/ gzhan yang lus kyi sgo nas rten gsum bzhengs pa/ phyag bskor la brtson pa/ ngag gi sgo nas mdo rgyud dang gzungs sngags zab mo klog pa/ kha ton bzlas brjod gsol 'debs la 'bad pa/ yid kyi sgo nas dad pa mos gus phan sems bzang po/ khyad par theg pa chen po'i chos bsgrub pa la byang chub kyi sems bskyed bzang pos zin pa'i lta ba rnam par dag pa dang*/ spyod pa'i tshul khrims rnam par dag pa gal che ba lags/ de dag ni nges 'byung bskyed nas blo bcos par gsungs pa rnams yin la skabs su bab pa'i lo rgyus cung zad brjod na/ theg dman nyan (327)thos kyi grub mtha' 'dzin pa brgya phrag las theg chen gyi sde snod 'dzin pa gcig gis khyad par 'phags/ theg chen pa brgya las kyang sngags lam la zhugs pa gcig gis khyad par 'phags/ sngags kyang bya spyod rnal 'byor bla med kyi rgyud sde bzhi po gong nas gong du khyad par 'phags pas/ deng sang bstan pa'i mthar thug pa'i dbang gis tshe 'dir 'bras bu dngos su thob pa dkon kyang*/ dbang thob cing dam tshig ma nyams la sngags kyi lta spyod la the tshom med pa'i dad mos dang ldan na bskyed rdzogs kyi ting nge 'dzin cher nyams su ma lon kyang dbang po rab mi tshe gsum/

dbang po 'bring skye ba bdun/ dbang po tha ma'ang skye ba bcu drug nas 'bras bu mchog thob pa rgyal ba drug pa rdo rje 'chang gi gsung mi bslu ba'i tshad ma can yin/ de las da lam skabs su bab pa 'di ni ma rgyud thams cad kyi yang snying dpal 'khor lo sdom pa yin/ rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du lu dril nag gsum gtso bor gyur pa'i grub thob grangs med pa byon pa thams cad phal cher 'khor lo sdom pa'i sgo nas grub pa thob pa sha stag yin par snang la bka' srol yang mi 'dra ba nyi shu rtsa bzhi tsam byung ba phal cher bod du'ang byon la deng sang yang rgyun bzhugs par 'dug /thams cad las khyad par du 'phags pa snyan brgyud kyi skor 'di ni 'phags yul grub pa'i dbang phyug tai lo shes rab bzang pos rdo rje 'chang dngos su mjal nas byin gyis brlabs pas rgyud sde thams cad kyi mnga' bdag tu gyur kyang tshu rol mthong ba rnams kyi snang ngor bka' babs bzhi'i bla ma rnams brten nas de skabs su bzhugs so cog gi rgyud sde rnams gsan pa'i tshul bstan/ khyad par du gsang ba thams cad kyi 'byung gnas nub phyogs o rgyan yul du phebs nas chos sku ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dngos su mjal ba'i skabs/ rnal 'byor mas brda gsum bstan pas/ tai lo (328)pas brda'i don go ste/ sku tsaka li yi dkor mdzod nas// brgyud pa yid bzhin nor bu zhu// gsung yi ge bdun gyi dkor mdzod nas// smin lam yid bzhin nor bu zhu// thugs rdo rje rtse lnga'i pho brang nas// grol lam yid bzhin nor bu zhu// zhes gsol ba btab pas/ rnal 'byor mas brda'i don khrol bas/ dbang rab skal ldan gyi gang zag tu dgongs nas/ snyan brgyud nor bu rnam gsum gyi mdzod yongs su rdzogs par gtad nas/ mi rabs bcu gsum du chig brgyud kyi bka' rgyas btab/ de la paṇa chen nā ro pas mi lo bcu gnyis su bsten te dka' ba chen po bcu gnyis spyad pa'i mthar 'khor lo sdom pa spyi dang*/

khyad par snyan brgyud 'di nyid gnang bas grub pa'i go 'phang mthon por gshegs/ de la bod yul gyi lho brag mar pa lo tsā zhes phyi dar gyi lo tsā'i nang nas sus kyang 'gran zla med pa yongs su grags pa bcom ldan 'das dgyes mdzad rdo rje dang*/ ḍoṃ bi he ru ka mi'i srid pa bzung ba de nyid kyis dka' ba chen por spyad nas rgya gar dang bal yul du lan bzhi byon/ 'phags yul mtha' dbus med par phebs nas mkhas grub kyi bla ma brgya dang lnga bcu bsten te gsan bsam mtha' yas pa mdzad tshul rdo rje'i mgur las gsal ba ltar dang*/ khyad par paṇa chen nā ro pa nyid lo drug dang zla ba bdun bsten nas gsan bsam sgom pa chab cig tu mdzad pas grub pa'i dbang phyug chen por gyur nas 'phags yul du'ang grub thob kyi snyan pas khyab/ lan rjes mar phebs skabs dpal nā ro pa spyod pa la gshegs nas slob ma nyid dang skal mnyam re re tsam ma gtogs thun mong ba sus kyang mjal rgyu med pa la rje mar pas tshogs 'khor phul zhing gsol ba rtse gcig tu btab nas rgya gar gyi yul phyogs kun tu btsal bas byang puṣ+pa ha ri'i dgon par mngon sum du mjal nas zla ba drug bzhugs pa'i skabs snyan brgyud nor bu skor gsum (329)gdams pa zhus pas khyod la gdams pa 'di 'dra yod ces sus zer gsungs/ nga la bod na slob ma mi la thos pa dga' zhes bya ba zhig yod pas/ de la mkha' 'gro mas lung bstan byung zer zhus pas/ de ma thag thal mo sbyar te// byang phyogs mun pa'i smag rum na// gangs la nyi ma shar 'dra ba// thos pa dga' zhes bya ba yi// skyes bu de la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes gsungs nas dbu dud par mdzad pas phyogs de'i rtsi shing rnams kyang lho phyogs su mgo dud pa da lta'i bar du yod par bshad/ rje mar pa'i slob ma gtso bo ka chen bzhi las mes rngog mtshur gsum la bshad brgyud kyi bka' babs/ rje btsun mi la la sgrub brgyud kyi bka' babs te snyan brgyud nor bu rnam gsum gyi gdams ngag rdzogs par chig brgyud du gnang*/

rje btsun mi las mi'i lto gos thams cad spangs te mnga' ris stod kyi gangs brag rnams su zwa tshod dang ras gos tsam la brten te sku tshe gcig tu sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan btsugs pas bod yul tsam na yongs su grags pa'i grub thob chen po 'phags yul gyi grub chen rnams dang rnam dbyer med pa byung*/ de la slob ma mkha' spyod du gshegs pa brgyad sogs grangs las 'das pa byung yang gtso bor gyur pa/ nyi ma lta bu dwags po zla 'od gzhon nu dang*/ zla ba lta bu ras chung rdo rje grags pa gnyis yin la/ skabs shig tu rje btsun nyid la yi dam rdo rje phag mos lung bstan te thugs sras brgyad la snyan brgyud kyi dum bu re byin cig ces gsungs pa ltar gnang bar nges kyang ras pa zhi ba 'od dang*/ khyi ra ba mgon po rdo rje sogs phal cher mkha' spyod du gshegs pas brgyud pa 'dzin pa ni ma byung bar snang*/ ras chung rdo rje grags pa la gnang ba snyan brgyud 'bring po dang*/ mnyam med dwags po rin po che la gnang ba snyan brgyud rgyas pa dang*/ ngan rdzong ston pa byang chub rgyal por gnang ba la snyan brgyud bsdus pa zhes grags (330)shing*/ de gsum ka'i smin grol yig cha tshang ma'i rgyun bcas da lta'i bar ma nyams par bzhugs pa las/ skabs su bab pa 'di ni ras chung pa'i lugs yin/ de la'ang ras chung slob ma grub thob chen po khyung tshang ras pa nas rim par byon te brgyud pa bco brgyad pa gtsang smyon he ru ka'i bar du byon pa rnams la/ rtsa ba rdo rje'i tshig rkang dang*/ yig cha sa bon tsam las yig tshogs rgyas par ma bzhugs par mngon la/ gtsang smyon he ru ka phyogs las rnam rgyal gyis nor bu skor gsum gyi gzhung*/ 'grel bshad/ khrid yig rnams sogs yig cha gsal la rgyas par mdzad cing*/ de'i slob ma rgod tshang ras pa sogs kyis kyang yig cha mang du mdzad pa'i rgyun deng sang yang bzhugs pa 'di ni ras chung rtsa ba'i bka' brgyud yin la/

yang 'gro mgon gtsang pa rgya ras gyis ras chung rdo rje grags pas sbas pa'i gter kha ro snyoms skor drug sogs lho brag mkhar chu nas spyan drangs pa dang*/ phyis chos rje 'brug pa la bka' babs pa'i ras chung snyan brgyud 'brug lugs kyang mchis pa las 'di rtsa ba'i bka' brgyud kyi lugs yin/ 'di'i smin byed kyi dbang bskur ba la slob ma dbang po rab 'bring tha gsum/ de re re la'ang nang gses kyis gsum gsum du dbye bas nang gses dgur yod pa'i dbang du mdzad nas dkyil 'khor sgrub tshul dang dbang bskur tshul rnam grangs bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis tsam gsungs kyang mdor bsdu na yab rgyal po lta bu'i dkyil 'khor bzhi/ yum btsun mo lta bu'i dkyil 'khor bzhi/ de rnams dang 'brel ba'i rang byung lus kyi dkyil 'khor dang dgu yod pa las da lam rim gyis pa rjes su bzung thabs yab kyi dkyil 'khor lha drug cu rtsa gnyis la brten pa'i smin byed kyi dbang bskur ba la slob ma lhag par gnas pa sta gon gyi rim pa dang*/ dngos gzhi'i dbang bskur ba gnyis su 'byung ba las/ da lta'i skabs su slob ma sta (331)gon gyi rim pa rnams bsgrub par bya ba lags pas de nyid zhu ba'i slad du zhing khams 'bul bar zhu/

zhes slob ma rnams kyis maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ de nas gsol ba gdab pa ni/ rdo rje phag mos mgrin 'khyud pa'i// dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste// slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol// byang chub chen po'i tshul bsten pa// mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo// dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol// byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol// thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu// mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol// zhes gsum/ de nas khyad par gyi chos bshad pa ni// 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen dag /u dum wā ra'i me tog bzhin// brgya lam na ni res 'ga' zhig /'byung 'gyur yang ni mi 'byung ngo*// gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul 'byung ba// de bas kyang ni dkon pa ste// gang gis sems can mnyam med don// bla med byed par nus pa yin// bskal pa bye ba bsam yas su// sngon du sdig pa byas pa gang*// dkyil 'khor bzang po mthong ma thag /de dag zad par 'gyur yin na// grags pa mtha' yas sngags brjod pa'i// tshul la gnas na smos ci dgos// skyob pa'i gsang sngags bzlas na ni// go 'phang bla na med par 'gyur// gang gis spyod pa mchog 'di la// blo gros shin tu mi g.yo na// sdug bsngal thams cad 'byung ba yi// ngan 'gro de yis spong bar 'gyur// bdag nyid chen po khyed rnams kyis// rnyed pa mnyam med de ring nyid// gang phyir rgyal ba sras bcas pa'i// bdag nyid chen po kun gyis ni// bstan pa 'di la khyed rnams kun// yongs su bzung ste skye bzhin pa// de phyir khyed rnams theg chen du// da lta rab tu skye bar 'gyur// theg pa chen po cher 'byung ba'i// lam mchog (332)'di ni dpal dang ldan// khyed rnams 'dir ni dong bas na// rang byung skal pa chen po pa// 'jig rten thams cad mkhyen pa yi// de bzhin gshegs pa rnams su 'gyur/

zhes dang*/ bskal par bsags pa'i mun pa yang*/ nyi zla dang sgron me la sogs pa'i 'od kyi snang ba skad cig ma gcig gis sel nus pa ltar/ tshe 'khor ba thog mtha' med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib rnams kyang ye shes kyi snang ba skad cig mas sel nus pa'i thabs gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i dbang zab mo bskur bas/ khyed rnams dga' ba dang spro bar gyis shig / ces brjod/ de nas sdom pa sbyin pa la byang sems kyi sdom pa ni rjes zlos byas te/ bla ma yi dam gtsor bzhugs pa'i// sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma tshogs kun// thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /che ge mo zhes bgyi ba bdag /bla med byang chub ma thob bar// dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ sogs lan gsum brjod/ rig 'dzin sngags kyi sdom pa sbyin pa ni/ bla ma yi dam nas/ dgongs su gsol/ gyi mthar// che ge mo zhes bgyi ba bdag /dus 'di nyid nas bzung nas ni// ji srid byang chub ma thob bar// ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i// byang chub sems ni bla na med// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang*// dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum// so sor brtan por bzung bar bgyi// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum// sangs rgyas rnal 'byor las skyes pa'i// sdom pa deng nas brtan por bzung*// rdo rje rigs mchog chen po la// rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang*// yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi// slob dpon dag kyang bzung bar bgyi// rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi// (333)dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la// nyin re bzhin yang dus drug tu// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin// byang chub chen po las byung ba'i// pad+ma'i rigs chen dag pa la// phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum// dam pa'i chos ni ma lus bzung*// las kyi rigs mchog chen po la// sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni// yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi// mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi// byang chub sems ni bla med mchog

/dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// bdag gis sdom pa ma lus bzung*// ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral// ma grol ba rnams bdag gis bgrol// dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing*// sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god/ ces lan gsum rjes zlos bya/ nang gi dbang bskur ba ni/ bla ma dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo yab yum dang bcas par gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od kyis slob ma rnams kyi sgo gsum gyi dri ma sbyangs shing*/ 'od du zhu hūm̐ re rer gyur te yab kyi zhal du drangs shing zhugs pa/ thugs kar rjes chags kyi mes 'od du zhu gsang gnas brgyud yum gyi mkhar byon pas he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa re rer gyur pa la slob dpon gyis go cha bgo ba ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs kar oṃ ha las rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po zhes sogs sgrub thabs ltar brjod la/ pad nyi ro'i gdan la bzhugs pa de dpa' bo dpa' mo thams cad me long nang gi gzugs brnyan ltar snang la rang bzhin med par gsal btab/ ye shes pa gzhug pa ni/ bla ma dkyil 'khor gtso bor gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad he ru ka'i rnam par oṃ bha ga wān shrī he ru ka tsakra saṃ pa ra wī ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes ye shes pa spyan drang*/ oṃ bha ga wān shrī he ru ka sogs mtshan sngags kyi mthar/ ār+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ (334 )zhes sogs kyis mchod/ ye shes pa de rnams khyed rang rnams la bstims byung snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod/ phyag rgya dang bcas/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ zhes rol mo bya/ slar yang bla ma'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ pad+ma ka ma lā ye s+t+waṃ/ oṃ pañtsa= ār+ghaṃ= chos sku nam mkha' bzhin du

sogs/ bcom ldan rgyal ba rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pas slob ma 'di rnams la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas rigs lnga'i 'khor rnams kyis rol ma'i sgra sna tshogs sgrogs shing mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul ba dang bcas te/ he ru ka dpal 'khor bcas kyis// sku gsung thugs las byung ba yi// sgrib gnyis bag chags sbyong byed pa'i// rdo rje'i dbang bskur chen po sbyin// oṃ gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta= zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa/ spyi bor 'khyil ba mi bskyod pa sprul sku'i cha byad can re res dbu brgyan par gyur pa de nyid yum gyi rtsibs logs g.yon nas thon/ pad nyi ro gdan gyi steng du gral rim gyis bzhag byung snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces slob dpon rdor dril pad kor dang bcas/ shrī tsakra saṃ ba ra pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ/ zhes pad+ma'i phyag rgya dang bcas te bzhag /de nas bsrung ba ni/ srang bu dmar po sum bltabs la 'bru gsum brjod bzhin mdud pa gsum bor ba oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin rlabs byas/ skyes pa'i dpung pa g.yon dang*/ bud med kyi g.yas su gnyis bltabs su bcing zhing mdud pa bor te/ yi ge bdun pa dang 'bru gsum brjod bzhin du dung chos su dri bzang las bum gyi chu blugs la rdo rje 'dzin pas srin lag g.yon pas mnan/ de bzhin dpral mgrin snying gar reg la/ de yang srung skud dmar po 'dom gang ba skyes pa'i g.yon dang*/ bud med kyi g.yas kyi dpung par 'ching ba des byang sems dkar dmar srung bar byed pa yin/ (335) dri bzang gi chus snying ga /mgrin pa/ dpral ba rnams su mas rim gyis thig le bkod la/ hūm̐ āḥ.oṃ/ brjod pas/ dpral bar sku rnam snang*/ mgrin par gsung 'od dpag med/ snying gar thugs mi bskyod pa sngon po rnams su gyur pa las/ sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs 'dus pa'i bdag nyid yin snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod/

mchod pa ni/ slob ma lhar gsal ba'i mdun du mchod pa sna lnga bshams la/ khyed rang rnams lhar gsal ba la slob dpon gyis mchod pa'i lha mo spros te mchod byung snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra ār+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ so shing 'dor ba ni/ maṇ+ḍal tshom bu dgu bkod la bzhag /so shing dri bzangs kyis byugs shing 'bru gsum gyis rin po cher byin gyis brlabs/ thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du bcug pas skyug sman zos pa ltar sdig sgrib skyug par bsams la so la cung zad drud de/ sngags kyis 'bul ba ni/ oṃ āḥdzi hwa/ badz+ra saṃ war+dha ni ye swā hā/ so shing 'o ma can sor bcu gnyis pa 'di/ rang gi so la cung zad drung la skyug sman zos pa ltar/ sdig sgrib thams cad skyug par bsams la/ oṃ badz+ra ha sa ha/ zhes tshom bu dbus ma la the tshom med par phul/ de ltar phul bas rtse mo me tog yod pa de rang dang bla ma tshom bu dbus ma la bstan na mchog gi dngos grub thob/ steng du bstan na rig 'dzin gyi go 'phang thob/ 'og tu sa la gnas pa'i gter gyi dngos grub thob/ phyogs bzhir phrin las bzhi/ mtshams bzhir dngos grub sna re thob par lung bstan to// skyor chu sbyin pa ni/ las bum gyi chus bkrus pas sdig sgrib dag par mos pa gyis la khrus mdzod/ ces dang yig brgya brjod/ de nas rmi lam brtag phyir ku sha sbyin pa ni/ ku sha'i chun po che ba lag g.yas dang chung ba g.yon du gtad/ che ba gdan/ chung bas sngas byas la seng ge'i nyal stabs kyis nyal dgos pas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang ku sha'i gdan la 'dug nas bdud btul zhing sangs rgyas pa yin pas/ khyed (336)rang rnams kyang chun po che ba gdan dang*/ chung ba sngas su gyis la bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs la mgo bstan te seng ge'i nyal stabs kyis nyal zhing*/ nangs par dbang zab mo thob yong bas re dga' snyam pa dang*/ rmi lam bzung dgos snyam pas nyol/

zhes brjod/ dge ba bsngos la slob ma rnams grol/ de nas slob dpon gyis grub na gtor 'bul dang tshogs mchod sogs rjes kyi rim pa bya/ mi 'grub na gtor 'bul mchod bstod tsam dang*/ nongs bshags shis brjod sogs byas pas grub bo// bzhi pa dkyil 'khor sta gon ni/ rdul tshon dkyil 'khor bzhengs pa'i skabs thig tshon gyi bya ba rnams dgos kyang 'dir stegs bu gtsang mar khebs kyis bkab pa'i steng ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor mtshan nyid dang ldan pa bkram/ dbus su mañdzi'i khar sngar sta gon byas pa'i rnam rgyal bum pa/ dung chos gzungs rdor bcas bkod/ g.yas g.yon rnams su rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan/ rdo rje/ dril bu/ mdun ngos su gsang dbang thod chang bdud rtsi ril bu sbyar ba dang*/ sher dbang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bzhag /logs gang bder snod gcig tu mnga' gsol chas thor tshugs skra tshab thal raka zhag gsum thod skam dbu rgyan thod rlon do shal rus rgyan sbrul chun bcas phyogs bsdus/ mi lpags glang lpags stag sham/ ro gdan/ rdo rje dril bu/ gri gug thod pa/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang cang te'u/ thod rnga dang rkang gling rnams dngos sam ri mor bris pa/ snod gcig tu rjes gnang chas/ nor bu/ ral gri/ bgrang phreng*/ glegs bam/ mig thur/ dgang gzar blugs/ sna tshogs rdo rje/ mda' gzhu/ dug sbrul dang bud med gzugs bzhag /dkyil 'khor gyi mtha' skor du mchod yon dang nyer spyod g.yon bskor/ rgyab phyogs sogs gang bder 'bul gtor bshos zlum bza' btung bzung dgus bskor ba rnams bkod/ snod gzhan zhig tu slob ma mchod pa mchod yon nyer spyod/ 'dod yon lnga bcas gang bder bzhag /gzhan yang sngon gtor sogs nye bar mkho ba'i yo byad rnams 'du bya'o// gnyis pa dbang don dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa la/ thog mar sgrub thabs ltar sngon 'gro gtor ma btang ba nas bzlas pa bsdu ldang gi bar bdag bskyed tshang bar btang*/

(337) bum bskyed bzlas pa khyugs tsam dang bum lha bdud rtsir bsgyur/ de nas mdun bskyed dkyil 'khor bsang sbyang*/ mdun rten mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las nam mkha'i khams su e e las sogs sgrub thabs ltar bskyed chog rdzogs par btang*/ go cha bgo/ gnas gsum byin gyis brlab/ ye shes pa gzhug pa'ang de ltar la dpag tu med pas bskor ba dang*/ sta gon gyi dkyil 'khor nam mkhar bzhugs pa rnams kyang spyan drangs/ oṃ gu ru bha ga wān sogs sngags dang*/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ 'i rjes su/ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*// bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzad 'joms mdzad lha// dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa'i// bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// bcom ldan bskal pa grangs med du ma ru// 'gro la brtse phyir thugs rje rnam sbyangs shing*// smon lam rgya chen dgongs pa yongs rdzogs pa'i// khyed bzhed 'gro don mdzad dus 'di lags na// de phyir chos dbyings pho brang lhun grub nas// rdzu 'phrul byin rlabs sna tshogs ston mdzad cing*// mtha' yas sems can tshogs rnams bsgral ba'i phyir// yongs dag 'khor dang bcas te gshegs su gsol/ zhes dang*/ oṃ badz+ra ār+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā sa mchod yon dang*/ pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ gyis gdan 'bul/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī hūm̐ gis khrus gsol/ mchod rdzas dam pa 'di dag dang*// 'jig rten khams kyi mchod rdzas kun// thams cad blo yis blangs nas ni// bcom ldan 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// oṃ gu ru bha ga wān shrī he ru ka tsakra saṃ pa raṃ wī ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra ār+ghaṃ nas/ shab+da 'i bar gyis mchod/ bstod par 'os pa thams cad la// zhing rdul kun gyi grangs snyed kyis// lus btud pa yis rnam kun tu// mchog tu dad pas bstod par bgyi//

zhes mchod bstod bya/ oṃ gu ru sogs nas/ sa pa ri wā ra dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ(338)ye shes pa dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor la thim pas dbyer med du gyur/ dbang bskur ba ni/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas sogs/ rigs bdag gi dbu rgyan la thim bar dang*/ mchod bstod/ bzlas pa bcas sgrub thabs bzhin bya/ bzlas dmigs rdo li'am bde chen bzlas pa dang sbyar la bzlas grangs skabs bstun bya/ de nas mchod bstod rgyas par 'bul ba'i thog mar mchod pa kha gsos la sgrub thabs ltar byin brlab/ dang po phyi mchod ni/ gtsang bde bsil sogs yan lag brgyad ldan chab// yid kyi gdung sel kun dga'i dpal ster ba'i// lha yi mchod yon dam pa'i mchod pa 'di// bla ma dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnam la 'bul// oṃ gu ru bha ga wān shrī he ru ka tsakra saṃ pa ra wī ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra ār+ghaṃ pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye ā hūm̐/ de bzhin du/ kha dog rnam par bkra ba'i 'dab phreng las// sa phyogs bsung zhim ngad pas bsil sbyin mkhan// mig gi bdud rtsir bzhad pa'i me tog 'di// bla ma dkyil 'khor lha tshogs=

sngags thog mtha' gong ltar la/ badz+ra puṣ+pe= rang byung dri ngad sbyar ba'i spos kyi sprin// nam mkha'i ba mthar gtibs las zhing khams kun// rab tu zhim pos kun dgar byed pa 'di/ bla ma= badz+ra dhū pe= nyi zla nor bu'i zer phreng 'bru mar mes// ma lus mun pa'i dpal 'phrog snang ba yis// nyin mtshan mi phyed kun tu gsal ba 'di// bla ma= badz+ra ā lo ke= dri med chab la tsan+dan ga pur dang*// gur gum la sogs rnam par sbyar ba'i rdzas// bsil bde nyon mongs tshad nad drung 'byin dri// bla ma= badz+ra gan+dhe= kha dog dri dang ro brgyar ldan pa'i bshos// ji tsam myong yang mi mthun med pa yi// lha yi zhal zas bda' dgu ji snyed pa// bla ma= badz+ra nai wi d+ya= rnga sil dung dang rgyud mang cha lang sogs// yan lag 'bum sde'i sgra dbyangs snyan sgrogs pa// rol mo'i khyad par ma lus ji snyed kun// bla ma=(339)badz+ra shab+da pū dza/ sogs kyis mchod cing rol mo bya'o// 'dod yon lnga 'bul ba ni/ rab 'byams zhing gi dkyil 'khor thams cad bar// rgyal ba'i spyan la mdzes pa ma lus kun// gcig bsdus gzugs kyi rdo rje'i sgyu 'phrul dpyid// bla ma dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul// oṃ gu ru= badz+ra rū pa pū dza= rab 'byams zhing gi= rgyal ba'i snyan la 'jebs pa ma lus kun// gcig bsdus sgra yi rdo rje'i sgyu 'phrul dpyid// bla ma= badz+ra shab+da= rab 'byams= rgyal ba'i shangs la zhim pa ma lus kun// gcig bsdus dri yi rdo rje'i sgyu 'phrul dpyid// bla ma= badz+ra gan+dhe= rab 'byams= rgyal ba'i ljags la bda' ba ma lus kun// gcig bsdus ro yi rdo rje'i sgyu 'phrul dpyid// bla ma= badz+ra ra sa= rab 'byams= rgyal ba'i sku la bde ba ma lus kun// gcig bsdus reg bya rdo rje'i sgyu 'phrul dpyid// bla ma= badz+ra spar+she pū dza= de'i rjes 'brel phyi snod 'jig rten 'bul ba ni/

bdag pos bzung dang ma bzung mchod pa'i tshogs// dngos dang yid kyi 'phrul 'khor las byung ba'i// sgyu 'phrul rdo rje'i rol rtsal mchod pa'i sprin// bla ma dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul// nang bcud 'bul ba ni/ bdag lus phung khams 'phral yun gtan bde dang*// mkha' khyab zhing gi 'gro ba longs spyod bcas// rgyal ba rnams kyi 'bangs su bdag 'bul na// rjes bzung brtse bas dgongs te bzhes su gsol// gnyis pa nang mchod bdud rtsi 'bul ba ni// mtheb srin gyis bdud rtsi 'thor zhing*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dman pa'i yul las rab 'das shing*// rgyal ba kun gyi dam tshig mchog /dngos grub kun gyi gzhir gyur pa'i// bdud rtsi mchog gi mchod pa 'bul// rdo rje 'chang chen rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// tai lo nā ro mar pa mi la'i zhabs// ras chung rdor grags khyung tshang ras pa dang*// grub thob rnam gsum (340)zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// zhang ston lo tsā 'gro mgon dhā ra shrī// bsod nams rgyal mtshan 'khrul zhig ras ma dang*// gzi brjid rgyal mtshan dbang phyug shes rab rje// ri khrod ras chen zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// gzhon nu dpal ldan nam mkha' rgyal mtshan dang*// ngag gi dbang po rab 'byams chos kyi rje// gtsang smyon he ru rgod tshang ras chen pa// sangs rgyas rdo rje'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// byams pa phun tshogs khyab bdag grub mchog dbang*// nam mkha'i mtshan can phrin las rgya mtsho dang*// karma bshad sgrub rgyal mchog 'chi med dbang*// bstan pa'i sgron me'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// yon tan rgya mtsho 'dzam gling grags pa'i zhabs// ngag gi dbang po ye shes skal bzang dang*// dpal ldan rgya mtsho nges don bstan pa 'dzin// chos kyi rgya mtsho'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// mthu stobs rgya mtsho rin chen 'od zer pa// phrin las dbang phyug kun bzang rdo rje dang*// o rgyan rnam grol rtsa ba'i bla ma sogs// snyan nas brgyud pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/

dpal ldan 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rgyud sde bzhi dang 'brel ba'i yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ ma mgon lcam dral la sogs pa chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dkar phyogs skyong ba'i gzhi gnas yul bdag rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ 'gro ba rigs drug gi sems can thams cad yi dam gyi lhar gsal ba'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rang gi lcer myangs la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ brjod/ gsum pa gsang ba'i mchod pa ni/ kha dog dbyibs legs yid 'ong rgyan spras ma// sku mdog sngon mo mchod rdzas pi waṃ 'dzin// zag med bde ster ye shes lha mo 'di// bla ma dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul// oṃ badz+ra bī ṇe āḥhūm̐/ kha dog= sku mdog ser mo mchod rdzas (341)gling bu 'dzin// zag med= bla ma= oṃ badz+ra waṃ she āḥhūm̐/ kha dog= sku mdog dmar mo mchod rdzas rnga zlum 'dzin// zag med= bla ma= mṛ daṃ ge= kha dog= sku mdog ljang gu mchod rdzas rdza rnga 'dzin// zag med= bla ma= mu ra dze= kha dog= bzhad ma dmar mo 'dzum pa'i bzhin ldan zhing*// zag med= bla ma= hā s+ye= kha dog= sgeg ma sngon mo mdzes pa'i 'gying bag can// zag med= bla ma= lā s+ye= kha dog= glu ma ljang gu snyan pa'i dbyangs len pa'i// zag med= bla ma= gi tī= kha dog= gar ma ser mo mdzes pa'i gar bsgyur ma// zag med= bla ma= nṛ t+ye= kha dog= sku mdog dkar mo mchod rdzas me tog 'dzin// zag med= bla ma= puṣ+pe= kha dog= sku mdog sngon mo mchod rdzas bdug spos 'dzin// zag med= bla ma= dhū pe= kha dog= sku mdog dmar mo mchod rdzas mar me 'dzin// zag med= bla ma= dī paṃ= kha dog= sku mdog ljang gu mchod rdzas dri chab 'dzin// zag med= bla ma= gan+dhe= kha dog= gzugs ma dkar mo mchod rdzas me long 'dzin// zag med=

bla ma= ā dar+she= kha dog= ro ma dmar mo mchod rdzas zhal zas 'dzin// zag med= bla ma= ra sa= kha dog= reg ma ser mo mchod rdzas na bza' 'dzin// zag med= bla ma= spar+she= kha dog= dbyings ma sngon mo mchod rdzas chos 'byung 'dzin// zag med bde ster ye shes lha mo 'di// bla ma dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul// oṃ badz+ra dha rme āḥhūm̐/ bzhi pa de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa ni/ gnas lugs rang ngo shes pa'i shes rab dang*// bdag pas gzhan gces ldan pa'i snying rje dang*// rang bzhin dbyer med zung 'jug mchod pa 'di// bla ma dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul// srid zhi rtog dpyod bral ba'i mnyam gzhag (342)dang*// snang ba stong par myong ba'i rjes thob dang*// ngo bo mnyam rjes khyab gdal mchod pa 'di// bla ma dkyil 'khor= sna tshogs snang ba stong pa'i rol rtsed 'di// sku gsum lhun grub sgyu ma'i gar mkhan la// yongs grub mi 'bral chos dbyings mchod pa 'di// bla ma= mchod gnas dam pa mchod mkhan 'khor gsum po// dbyer med chos nyid ngang du ro gcig pa'i// bla med blo 'das mchod pa dam pa 'di// bla ma= dge bas 'gro kun de nyid rtogs par shog / ces 'khor gsum dmigs med kyi gnas lugs ngang la mnyam par bzhag /bstod pa rgyud nas byung ba'i rkang brgyad ni/ hūm̐/ bcom ldan mgon po dpa' bo'i dbang phyug ni// bskal pa'i me ltar 'od zer rab tu 'bar// ral pa'i cod pan dbu yi rgyan du bcings// mche ba rab gtsigs drag shul 'jigs pa'i zhal// sku la phyag rgya gzi brjid ldan pa po// dgra s+t+wa zhags pa kha ṭ+wāṃ mdung sogs bsnams// rab 'jigs stag gi pags pa'i gos 'dzin pa'i// sku chen dud kas bgegs 'joms mdzad la 'dud// hūm̐/ bcom ldan rnam kun rdo rje phag mo che// 'jig rten gsum gzhan rgol bas mi tshugs shing*// 'byung po'i 'jigs pa ma lus rdo rje phag mos 'joms// rdo rje gdan bzhugs tshangs pa las rgyal zhing*// bdud kyi 'jigs pa ma lus skem zhing pham mdzad pa// skye gnas 'byung ba kun gyi rang bzhin gzugs// sa gsum dbang phyug chos rnams yongs rdzogs mdzad// rnal 'byor 'dod pa'i dbang phyug chen mor bstod/

spro na/ bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi bstod pa 'bring po ni/ oṃ/ srid zhi'i dge legs ma lus stsol mdzad pa'i// bka' brgyud bla ma dam pa rnams dang ni// bcom ldan 'khor lo sdom pa 'khor bcas la// bdag gis sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// āḥ pad nyi 'jigs byed dus mtshan gdan steng na// srid zhi mnyam sbyor 'khor (343)lo bde mchog ni// mthing nag zhal bzhi bcu gnyis phyag can gyi// zhal rnams sngo ljang dmar ser spyan gsum ldan// mche gtsigs smin ma sma ra ag tshom ser// ral pa gyen brdzes zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan// dang po'i phyag gnyis rdor dril yum la 'khyud// tha ma zhing glang lpags rlon brgyangs te 'dzin// lhag ma g.yas rnams cang te'u gri gug dang*// dgra s+t+wa rtse gsum 'dzin cing g.yon rnams kyang*// kha ṭ+wāṃ thod khrag zhags pa tshangs mgo bsnams// gar dgu'i nyams ldan dur khrod chas kyis mdzes// 'khril sbyor rdo rje phag mo dmar mo ni// rab mdzes yid 'ong zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma// gri thod 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud cing stob// sgyu ma'i gar gyis sa gsum 'gro ba 'dul// bcom ldan bde mchog yab yum phyag 'tshal bstod/ hūm̐/ he ru ka dpal yab yum sprul pa'i 'khor// pad 'dab brgyad kyi phyogs bzhir rim pa bzhin// mkha' 'gro lā ma dum skyes gzugs can ma// sngo ljang dmar ser zhal gcig phyag bzhi yis// gri gug cang te'u thod khrag kha ṭ+wāṃ 'dzin// zhabs rnams skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis// pad 'dab nyi dkyil ro yi gdan la bzhugs// lang tsho rab rgyas rus pa'i rgyan gyis mdzes// bde chen gsang yum rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// sa gsum 'khor lo'i rtsibs gyur nyer bzhi yi// yul rnams skyong byed dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// thod dum rab gtum mo sogs sku mdog sngo// myug can sa srung ma sogs sku mdog dmar// stobs chen 'khor lo ma sogs sku mdog dkar// yab rnams zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i dang po rnams// g.yas rnams rang rang rigs bdag phyag mtshan dang*// g.yon rnams de mthun dril 'dzin yum la 'khyud// de 'og g.yas rnams cang te'u 'dzin cing 'khrol// g.yon 'og rnams kyang kha ṭ+wāṃ rtse gsum 'dzin// (344)rus pa'i rgyan can gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan// 'khril sbyor yum rnams rgyan dang cha lugs dang*// phyag mtshan 'khyud stangs gtso mo dang mtshungs pa'i// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// sgo mtshams bzhugs pa'i khwa 'ug khyi phag gdong*// gshin rje brtan po mche 'joms dpa' mo rnams// rang rang gnas pa'i phyogs mtshams sku mdog can// zhal phyag la sogs gsang yum bzhi dang mtshungs// ye shes mkha' 'gro rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// pho brang steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad na// yid 'ong mchod sprin du mas mchod byed pa'i// lha mo bcu drug rgyud sde bzhi la sogs// bar khyams gang ba'i 'khor la phyag 'tshal lo// dur khrod nang bzhugs phyogs skyong zhing skyong klu// rnal 'byor pho mo 'dre srin yi dwags dang*// sha za smyo byed 'byung po ro langs sogs// mtha' yas phyi 'khor rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// bcom ldan 'khor lo sdom pa 'khor bcas la// phyag 'tshal mchod 'bul sdig pa ma lus bshags// dge la yi rangs chos 'khor bskor bzhin du// mya ngan mi 'da' rtag par bzhugs su gsol// dge ba bla med byang chub chen por bsngo//

'dir phyag len ltar smon lam ni/ lha mo tshad ma dam tshig tshad ma dang*// des gsungs tshig kyang mchog tu tshad ma ste// bden pa de yis lha mo mchog gis ni// bdag la rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig / de nas sgrub mchod kho na'i skabs yin na/ rang nyid kyi dam tshig gso ba dang*/ lam dus kyi bya ba gtso bo yin pas bdag 'jug len brgyud sde spyi'i phyag len yin pa dang*/ slob ma gzhug pa'i skabs dang slob dpon rtogs dgongs dman na bdag 'jug rdzogs par ma blangs thabs med yin pas 'og tu slob ma la dbang bskur ba'i skabs ltar 'dor len byed par byas te dbang bskur rdzogs par blang ngo*// gnyis pa dngos gzhi dbang bskur ba la gnyis/ 'jug pa dang*/ dngos gzhi'o// dang po la phyi nang gnyis las (345) phyi 'jug gi sdom tshig tu sa bcad bcur gsungs pa'i dang por khrus bya ba ni/ slob dpon kyis/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs brjod/ las rdor gyis sgo drung du slob ma rnams la thog mar chu gtsang*/ de nas las bum gyis khrus bya/ gnyis pa bgegs bskrad pa ni/ slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i sprul pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i sku las skyes pa'i ye shes kyi me dang*/ thugs ka'i mtshon cha'i char gyis bgegs bskrad par bsams la thun gyis brab cing dril bu drag tu dkrol/ oṃ su bha ni sogs brjod/ gsum pa maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba ni/ sems bskyed gsal btab/ da lam skabs su bab pa rigs drug pa rdo rje 'chang yab yum gyi gsang tshig bde mchog mkha' 'gro snyan brgyud ras chung rdo rje grags pa'i lugs kyi smin byed rgyas par bsgrub pa la sta gon gyi rim pa rnams khar sang gi skabs su song zin/ de ring dbang bskur dngos la 'jug pa dang dngos gzhi gnyis las thog mar 'jug pa'i chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du dmigs te zhing khams 'bul bar zhu/ zhes maṇ+ḍal rgyas par phyag len ltar 'bul du gzhug

/bzhi pa rmi lam dris nas bzang na spro bskyed dang ngan na sgrib sbyong dgos par gsungs kyang spyi tsam du/ khyed rang rnams la mdang sum rmi lam bzang ngan gang byung rung sgyu ma dang rmi lam gyi chos rnams bden par ma grub pas bzang ngan gang byung yang dga' mi dga'i re dogs kyi rtog pa ma byed cig / 'dir 'byed rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i sbyin sreg bya bar gsungs pas 'dzom na sku dang thab khung sogs slob dpon mdun du bkod/ ma 'dzom na me snod tsam bzhag /las rdor gyis me long du til nag blugs pa slob ma rnams kyi sngon tu 'grim/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros khyed rang rnams la phog pas sdig sgrib thams cad rang rang gi snying gar yi ge kaṃ nag po'i rnam par 'dus/ de'ang bya phag sbrul gsum gyi rnam par gyur nas kha'i sgo nas thon te mdun gyi til la thim par bsam/ til snod bzed la/ hag brjod/ de slob dpon mdun du bzhag / oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mchod rdzas bdud rtsi'i (346)rang bzhin tu gyur/ mdun du zhi ba'i thab khung zlum zhing dkar ba mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs shing me dkar gsal du 'bar ba'i dbus na za byed rdo rje mkha' 'gro mthing nag rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin cing khro bo'i chas thams cad kyis brgyan pa zhal rab tu gdangs pa las ye shes kyi me 'bar ba la bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul bas mnyes par bsams la/ g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis til 'bul zhing*/ oṃ ḍā ka kha kha khā hi/ sarba pā paṃ da ha na bha smin ku ru ye swā hā/

zhes bdun nam nyer gcig tsam brjod la mi dmigs par bzhag / las bum gyi chu byin pas phyi nang gi sdig sgrib thams cad dag par mos shig /oṃ hrīḥbi shud+dha sarba pā paṃ nish+tsa saṃ shod+dha ya sarba bi kalpan a pa na ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ slob ma rnams kyi las dang nyon mongs pa byur dang skal pa ngan pa thams cad shan+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes brjod/ rmi lam gyi skor 'di bdag 'jug skabs mi dgos so// lnga pa gsol ba gdab pa ni/ rdo rje phag mos mgrin 'khyud pa'i// dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste// slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol// byang chub chen po'i tshul ston pa'i// mgon po chen por bdag 'tshal lo// dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol// byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol// thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu// mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol// drug pa lha la gsol gdab dang gnang sbyin ni/ slob dpon gyis dril bu res 'jog tu 'khrol la/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas// he ru ka yi grong khyer mchog /snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di ru ni// bdag gis slob ma gzhug par bgyi/ zhes brjod/ bdun pa sdom pa bsgrag pa ni/ khyed rnams snying po'i dkyil 'khor du 'jug cing zhugs nas/ tshe 'dir phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob par 'dod pas spyir so thar byang sems/ khyad par du rig 'dzin sngags kyi sdom pa mtha' dag ma nyams par bsrung dgos/ de ltar rig pa 'dzin pa sngags kyi (347)dam tshig dang sdom pa bsrungs pas/ sdom pa thams cad bsrung bar 'gyur bas sngags sdom bsrung dgos/ de yang rigs lnga'i dam tshig bsrung ba la tshang ste/ phyi nang gi 'byung ba lnga/ phung khams skye mched la sogs te/ chos thams cad rgyal ba rigs lnga'i rang bzhin du gnas pa yin la/ dam tshig dang sdom pa thams cad kyang rigs lnga'i dam tshig dang sdom pa'i khongs su 'dus pas/

der bsdus nas bsrung dgos pas srungs shig / ces bsgo/ brgyad pa sdom pa bzung ba ni/ sngar so thar byang sems kyi sdom pa ma thob pa thob par byed pa/ thob nas nyams chag byung ba sor chud par byed cing*/ nyams chag med na gong 'phel du byed pa yin pas/ so thar byang sems kyi sdom pa len snyam pas tshig don mthun pa'i sgo nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod// bla ma yi dam gtsor bzhugs pa'i// sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma tshogs kun// thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ che ge mo zhes bgyi ba bdag /bla med byang chub ma thob bar// dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sdig pa mi dge so sor bshags// 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang*// sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung*// sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la// byang chub bar du bdag skyabs mchi// rang gzhan don ni rab sgrub phyir// byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi// byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas// sems can thams cad bdag gis mgron du gnyer// byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas myur thob shog / lan gsum gyis thun mong gi sdom pa dang*/ bla ma yi dam gtsor bzhugs pa'i// sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma tshogs kun// thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol// che ge mo zhes bgyi ba bdag /dus 'di nyid nas bzung nas ni// ji srid byang chub ma thob bar// (348)ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i// byang chub sems ni bla na med// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang*// dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum// so sor brtan por bzung bar bgyi// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum// sangs rgyas rnal 'byor las skyes pa'i// sdom pa deng nas brtan por bzung*// rdo rje rigs mchog chen po la// rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang*// yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi// slob dpon dag kyang bzung bar bgyi// rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi// dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la// nyin re bzhin yang dus drug tu// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin// byang chub chen po las byung ba'i// pad+ma'i rigs chen dag pa la// phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum// dam pa'i chos ni ma lus bzung*// las kyi rigs mchog chen po la// sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni// yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi// mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi// byang chub sems ni bla med mchog

/dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// bdag gis sdom pa ma lus bzung*// ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral// ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol// dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing*// sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god/ ces lan gsum gyis sngags sdom gzung*/ dgu pa me tog dang gdong g.yog ni mtshams sbyor spyi ltar byas/ ā khaṃ bī ra hūm̐/ zhes me tog sbyin/ oṃ tsak+ṣu bhan+dha ba ra ma ṇa ye hūm̐/ zhes ras yug dmar pos gdong 'ching*/ bcu pa byang chub kyi sems gnyis bskyed pa ni/ khyed rang rnams lhar gsal ba'i snying gar kun rdzob byang sems kyi ngo bo zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ba re re bsam/ de'i steng du don dam byang chub sems kyi ngo bo rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa re sgoms shig / slob dpon kyis rdo rje 'phred dang gyen du 'jog bzhin pas (349)oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta ut+pa da yā mi su ra ta sa ma ya s+t+waṃ hoḥ sid+dhi badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ/ zhes dang*/ ngas khyed rnams dpal he ru ka'i dkyil 'khor du gzhug par bya yis/ yi dam lha yi dam tshig dang*/ byang chub kyi sems ma dor bar gong 'phel du gyis shig /'bras bu dam pa sku gnyis thob par 'gyur ro// gnyis pa nang 'jug gi dam tshig bdun tu gsungs pa'i/ dang po dkyil 'khor nang du gzhug pa ni/ slob dpon dkyil 'khor gtso bo'i sprul pa he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa zhig srung 'khor gyi phyi rol du byon te/ khyed rang rnams kyi lag nas khrid de rdzu 'phrul gyis skad cig /'khor nang du tshud par gyur snyam pa mdzod/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ gnyis pa phyag 'tshal ba ni/ de ltar slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i sprul pa de nyid kyi phyi bzhin phyin pas/ shar sgo'i thad kyi nam mkha' la yar bltas pas rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma la brgyud pa'i bla ma'i tshogs kyis bskor te bzhugs 'dug pa de la phyag 'tshal snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod// sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku// yid bzhin nor bu gtsug gi rgyan// tshogs kyi slob dpon tshogs kyi mchog

/dpal ldan sku la skyabs su mchi/ de nas rim bzhin phyin pas lho sgo'i thad du slebs pa de'i nam mkhar bltas pas yi dam 'khor lo sdom pa la rgyud sde bzhi'i lha tshogs kyis bskor te bzhugs 'dug pa la phyag 'tshal snyam pas/ 'khor ba'i 'khor lo rgyun gcod cing*// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor mdzad pa// bde mchog 'khor lo bde ba'i mchog /dpal ldan sku la skyabs su mchi// de nas nub sgo'i nam mkha' la yum rdo rje phag mo la 'khor rigs bzhi'i mkha' 'gros bskor te bzhugs pa la phyag 'tshal snyam/ sangs rgyas thams cad skyed pa'i yum// bcom ldan 'das ma rje btsun ma// ma gcig rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// dpal ldan ma la skyabs su mchi// de nas byang sgo'i thad kyi nam mkha' la (350)bltas pas rdo rje mched lcam thams cad dpa' bo dang dpa' mo'i tshul du bzhugs pa la phyag 'tshal snyam pas/ dpa' bo dpa' mo rdo rje yi// spyan can chos skyong rdo rje spun// ma lus lus pa med pa la// phyag 'tshal gus pas skyabs su mchi/ gsum pa dam bzhag la bzhi las/ phan yon gyi sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ rdo rje spyi bor bzhag / ngas khyed rnams la dkyil 'khor bzang po 'dir dbang zab mo bskur bas tshe 'dir phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub kyang thob par 'gyur na dngos grub gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos/ de lta bu'i dbang bskur zab mo sbyin par bya yi/ khyed rnams kyis he ru ka'i gsang chen dam pa 'di dbang ma thob pa dang*/ ma dad pa rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ sam+bu ṭi las/ khyab 'jug dang dbang phyug chen po dang tshangs pa dang nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas rnams kyi spyod yul ma yin pa'i phyir gsang ba'o// zhes gsungs/ gal te smras na bu khyod dam tshig nyams par 'gyur bas/ rdo rje 'dis khyod kyi mgo bo 'gems par 'gyur ro// zhes brjod/ gnyis pa nyes dmigs kyi sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/

he ru ka dpal deng khyod kyi// snying la yang dag zhugs par 'gyur// gal te tshul 'di smras na ni// de ma thag tu dral gyur nas// rdo rje'i dmyal bar gnas bzhin du// mi bzad sdug bsngal myong bar 'gyur// de bas dam tshig bsrung bar gyis/ gsum pa phan yon nyes dmigs gnyis ka'i sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ las bum gyi sbyor chu blud la/ 'di ni khyod kyi dam tshig chu// dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed// dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub ni// rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis 'grub// oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta u da ka sa ma ya hūm̐ brjod/ bzhi pa rdo rje slob dpon bka' gnyan pa'i sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ deng phyin chad khyed rnams kyi dpal he ru ka de nga yin no// ngas ji ltar bsgo ba bzhin sgrub dgos so// ma bsgrubs na khyed rnams bka'i chad pa drag po'i sdug bsngal gyis gzir bam (351)spangs par tshe'i dus byas te sems can dmyal ba chen por gnas dgos par 'gyur ro// brjod/ bzhi pa ye shes pa dbab pa ni/ slob ma rnams sgo gsum gyi gnad gcun du gzhug la/ khaṇ+ḍa ro he sa bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyang*/ gzung 'dzin gyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las sa phyogs dag pa'i zhing khams gnas khang thar pa chen po'i gzhal med khang gi dbus su khyed rang rnams gang du gnas pa'i go sar pam̐ las pad+ma ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan bsgyel ba'i gdan la khyed rang rnams kyi sems nyid hūm̐ mthing nag las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa hūm̐ gis mtshan pa de las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las khyed rang rnams bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo sdom pa sogs kyi mngon rtogs sgrub thabs ltar la/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// yab kyi thugs kar oṃ ha las rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po

sogs nas/ gdan la bzhugs pa'o// yum gyi lte bar oṃ bam̐ sogs nas/ pad nyi ro'i gdan la bzhugs pa'o// bar dang*/ de'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon pos mtshan par gsal bar mos la gsol 'debs rjes zlos/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thams cad kyis/ bdag la dpal he ru ka dbab par mdzad du gsol/ lan gsum/ des na dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod cig /slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ dang*/ khyed rang rnams yi dam du gsal ba'i stong ra'i nang rtsa dbu ma pad+ma sngon po 'dab brgyad dang*/ khams dmar po nyi ma dkar po zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du rang 'dra'i ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' he ru ka tshon gang tsam gsal la dod pa mgar ba'i sol me las thon pa'i lcags bsregs lta bu las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i bla ma yi dam sangs (352)rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad rang 'dra'i sku dang yig 'bru phyag mtshan me'i rang bzhin 'od rab tu 'bar ba'i rnam par spyan drangs pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor gtso bo las kyang rang 'dra dpag tu med pa 'phros/ tsheg sgra 'ur sgra bcas/ snying ga'i he ru ka'i lus la thim pas he ru ka mer 'bar ba drag tu 'bar zhing rang lus mer 'bar bas mi bzod pa'i bde ba rgyas par gyur/ par bsams la sha chen dang gu gul gyi dud pa btang*/ rol mo drag tu 'khrol zhing rig pa hur phyungs la/ oṃ shrī he he ru ru kaṃ badz+ra dz+nyā na ā we sha ya ā we sha ya dza/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ zhes lan mang du brjod/ sku gsung thugs kyi ye shes dbab pa'i rtags lus ngag yid la ji ltar 'char na so sor ngo sprad/ gang ltar brtan par bya ba'i phyir spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag la/ oṃ shrī dz+nyā na he ru ka su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+rā ya swā hā/ lnga pa phrin las brtag cing*/ khyed rang rnams mig dar dang bcas pa'i mig gis dkyil 'khor gyi steng gi nam mkha' la kha dog ci 'drar mthong ba ltos shig

/ ces pa ltar gzhug /kha dog ji snang dris pas mthong tshul smra/ kha dog dkar por mthong na zhi ba/ ser pos rgyas pa/ dmar pos dbang*/ ljang gus drag po/ kha dog sna tshogs kyis las sna tshogs 'grub par 'gyur ba yin no// de nas me tog dbang thob myong ba rnams rang rang gi lhag pa'i lha la 'bul/ ma thob pa rnams dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo la dmigs te 'bul ba ni/ oṃ puṣ+pe ma la pra tīts+tsha hoḥ zhes ltos med du 'dor du gzhug / khyed rang rnams kyi me tog phog pa'i lha de las mar me gcig las gnyis mched kyi tshul du bye ste khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ puṣ+pe mā la sa ma ya hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing me tog spyi bor bcing*/ drug pa mig dbye ba ni/ 'byed pa'i phyag rgya dang bcas/ slob dpon gyis ma rig pa'i 'thib po bsal byung snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod/ he ru ka dpal deng khyod kyi// mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad// rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med// phye bas ye shes mthong (353)bar 'gyur/ oṃ badz+ra nai tra a pa ha ra pa ṭa laṃ hrīḥtrāṃ/ brjod/ bdun pa dkyil 'khor bstan pa ni/ slob dpon gyis/ thar pa chen po'i grong khyer mchog /ltos shig ltos shig sems dpa' che// dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos// me tog gang du lhung gyur pa// de ni khyod kyi lhag pa'i lha// de la dad pa rab tu bskyed// sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs// bskal pa bye ba du ma ru// sngon du sdig pa byas pa gang*// dkyil 'khor 'di 'dra mthong ma thag /de dag zad par 'gyur yin na// grags pa mtha' yas sngags brjod pa'i// tshul la gnas na smos ci dgos// skyob pa'i gsang sngags bzlas na ni// go 'phang bla na med par 'gyur// bdag nyid chen po khyed rnams kyis// rnyed pa mnyam med de ring rnyed// de phyir khyed rnams skal ldan 'gyur// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rigs skyes// dam tshig mchog la gnas par gyis/

nus na srung 'khor nas gtso bo'i bar mngon rtogs ltar rgyas par brjod/ mi nas na/ bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo sdom pa drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa mngon sum bzhin du mthong bar gyur/ zhes pa rnams brjod do// gnyis pa dngos gzhi dbang bskur ba la/ bum pa/ gsang ba/ sher ye/ tshig dbang bzhi las/ dang po bum dbang ni/

dngos gzhi'i dbang bskur ba'i thog mar bum dbang zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul/ zhes mtshams sbyar la/ phyi snang ba sna tshogs kyi maṇ+ḍal la// nang du ma ro gcig gi chag chag btab// rang gsal 'dzin med kyi me tog bkod// pha bla ma rnams kyi sku la 'bul// sku la phul ba'i bsod nams kyis// bdag gzhan lus kyi sgrib pa dag gyur cig /bdag gzhan lus la yon tan rdzogs pa dang*// bdag gzhan lus kyis 'gro don 'grub par shog / ces maṇ+ḍal sngon du 'gro bas/ mkhyen brtse ye shes lnga yi bdag /'gro ba'i ded dpon bla ma mchog /bcom ldan he ru (354)ka dpal gyis// bdag la bum dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab/ bum dbang gi sdom la bcu gcig tu gsungs pa'i dang por mi bskyod pa chu'i dbang ni/ las bum gyi chu 'thor la/ oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro hi sa bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyang*/ slob ma rnams mi dmigs te stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma ram̐ las nyi ma bam̐ las ro'i gdan gyi steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las mi bskyod 'khor lo sdom pa sku mdog sngon po zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis kyi g.yas pa drug gis rdo rje dang*/ g.yon pa drug gis des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa'i dang po gnyis kyis yum mā ma kī sngon mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa la 'khyud pa/ zhabs gnyis g.yas brkyang zhing g.yon bskum pa'i rol stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ rgyan dang cha lugs thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan par gyur/ de'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po mgrin par āḥdamar po thugs kar hūm̐ sngon pos mtshan par gyur/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros rang 'dra'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ badz+ra sa mā dza/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ dbang bskur bar gsol ba gdab pa ni/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/

zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang yul gyi dkyil 'khor gtso bo de bzhin gshegs pa yab rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ yum rnams kyis bum pa la sogs rdzas so sos dbang bskur/ mchod pa'i lha dang lha mo rnams kyis bkra shis pa'i glu dbyangs brjod cing mchod/ las dbang gi khro bo khro mo rnams kyis bgegs skrod pa'i las mdzad pa dang*/ bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur bar gyur bar bsams la/ rnam rgyal bum pa lag tu thogs te/ he ru ka dpal 'khor bcas kyi// sku gsung thugs las byung ba yi// sgrib gnyis bag chags (355)sbyong byed pa'i// rdo rje'i dbang bskur chen po sbyin// oṃ badz+ra u da ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ bum pa spyi bor bzhag cing bum chu myong*/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas sgo gsum gyi dri ma thams cad dag /lus thams cad bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis gang ste spyi bor 'khyil ba las mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan par gyur// de la mchod pa ni/ mchod yon bogs btegs la/ oṃ badz+ra ār+ghaṃ nas shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā'i bar brjod/ des mi bskyod pa chu'i dbang thob/ rnam shes kyi phung po dang nyon mongs pa zhe sdang gi dri ma dag /mi bskyod pa'i bskyed rim bsgom pa la dbang*// me long lta bu'i ye shes thob pa'i skal pa can du byas pa yin no// zhes rtogs pa brjod/ gnyis pa rin 'byung dbu rgyan gyi dbang ni/ slob ma dang dbang rdzas dbu rgyan gnyis ka bsang sbyang*/ slob ma dang dbang rdzas gnyis ka mi dmigs te stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ pam̐ las pad+ma/ ram̐ ram̐ las nyi ma/ bam̐ bam̐ las ro'i gdan gyi steng du/ trām̐ trām̐ las rin po che ser po trām̐ gyis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rin 'byung 'khor lo sdom pa sku mdog ser po zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis kyi g.yas pa drug gis rin po che dang*/

g.yon pa drug gis des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa'i dang po gnyis kyis yum rin chen sgrol ma ser mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa la 'khyud pa/ zhabs gnyis sogs gong bzhin la/ hūm̐ las 'od 'phros dkyil 'khor gtso bo'i thugs ka nas rang 'dra'i ye shes pa dang phyogs pa'i mchod 'os thams cad rin 'byung 'khor lo sdom pa'i rnam par badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ dbang rdzas la dbang bskur ba ni/ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thams cad kyis// 'di la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab pas dkyil 'khor pa rnams kyis dbang rdzas la dbang bskur bar mos la/ oṃ badz+rī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ (356) rnam rgyal bum chu 'thor/ zhes gsungs shing dbang rdzas kyi lha la dbang bskur bas sgo gsum gyi dri ma thams cad dag /lus thams cad bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis gang ste spyi bor 'khyil pa rin chen 'byung ldan du gyur/ ār+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ dbang rdzas kyi rin 'byung yab yum snyoms par zhugs 'od du zhu ba las rin po che'i cod pan du gyur/ yang slob mas gsol ba gdab pa ni/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ ces brjod/ dbu rgyan spyi bor bcings la/ sangs rgyas kun gyi dbu rgyan dbang*// de ring khyod la bskur bar bya// sangs rgyas mchog tu bsgrub pa'i phyir// dbu rgyan 'di yis mdzes par byos// oṃ rat+na mu ku ṭa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ he ru ka dpal sogs/ rnam bum chu 'thor la/ oṃ badz+rī bha ba a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes sogs gong ltar brjod/ spyi bor 'khyil ba las rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbur brgyan/ ār+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ des rin chen 'byung ldan cod pan gyi dbang thob/ tshor ba'i phung po dang nyon mongs pa nga rgyal gyi dri ma dag /rin chen 'byung ldan gyi sku bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu mnyam nyid ye shes mngon du 'gyur ba'i skal pa can du byas pa yin no//

gsum pa 'od dpag med rdo rje'i dbang ni/ slob ma dang rdo rje bsang sbyang*/ slob ma dang dbang rdzas rdo rje gnyis ka mi dmigs te sogs gong dbu rgyan skabs ltar la/ gdan gyi steng du hrīḥhrīḥlas pad+ma dmar po hrīḥs mtshan pa las sogs/ 'od dpag med 'khor lo sdom pa sku mdog dmar po zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis kyi g.yas pa drug gis pad+ma dang*/ g.yon pa drug gis des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa'i dang po gnyis kyis yum gos dkar mo dmar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa la 'khyud pa sogs/ hūm̐ las 'od 'phros dkyil 'khor gtso bo'i thugs ka nas rang 'dra'i ye shes pa dang phyogs bcu'i mchod 'os thams cad 'od dpag med 'khor lo sdom pa'i rnam par badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ dbang (357 )rdzas la dbang bskur ba ni/ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thams cad kyis sogs gong ltar/ 'khyil ba 'od dpag med du gyur nas dbu brgyan par/ gong ltar mchod/ 'od dpag med yab yum snyoms par zhugs 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas rdo rjer gyur par bsam/ yang slob mas/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thams cad= gsol btab rjes zlos bya/ slob dpon gyis/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i dbang*// de ring khyod la bskur bar bya// sangs rgyas kun tu rab bsgrub phyir// rdo rje 'di ni khyod kyis zungs// oṃ ma hā badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ he ru ka dpal sogs gong bzhin dang*/ 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan/ ār+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ des 'od dpag med rdo rje'i dbang thob/ 'du shes kyi phung po dang nyon mongs pa 'dod chags dag /'od dpag med kyi bskyed rim bsgom pa la dbang*// 'bras bu so sor rtog pa'i ye shes mngon du gyur pa'i skal pa can du byas pa yin no// bzhi pa don grub dril bu'i dbang ni/ slob ma dang dbang rdzas dril bu gnyis ka mi dmigs te

sogs nas/ gdan kyi steng du a a las ral gri ljang gu as mtshan pa las sogs/ don grub 'khor lo sdom pa sku mdog ljang gu zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis kyi g.yas pa drug gis ral gri dang*/ g.yon pa drug gis des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa'i dang po gnyis kyis yum dam tshig sgrol ma ljang gu sogs/ mchod 'os thams cad don grub 'khor lo sdom pa'i rnam par badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ dbang rdzas la dbang bskur/ 'khyil ba don grub tu gyur nas dbu brgyan par gyur/ gong ltar mchod/ don grub yab yum snyoms par zhugs/ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas dril bur gyur/ slob mas/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor lha tshogs sogs/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bshad// byang chub mchog tu rgyal bas bzhed// khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu zungs// oṃ ma hā ghāṇ+ḍe a (358)bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ he ru ka dpal sogs dbang bskur/ don yod grub pas dbur brgyan par gyur/ ār+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ des don yod grub pa dril bu'i dbang thob/ 'du byed kyi phung po dang nyon mongs pa phrag dog dag /don yod grub pa'i bskyed rim bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu bya ba grub pa'i ye shes mngon du gyur pa'i skal pa can du byas pa yin no// lnga pa rnam par snang mdzad ming gi dbang ni/ slob ma mi dmigs te stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma ram̐ las nyi ma pam̐ las ro'i gdan gyi steng du oṃ las 'khor lo oṃ gyis mtshan pa las sogs/ rnam snang 'khor lo sdom pa sku mdog dkar po zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis kyi g.yas pa drug gis 'khor lo dang*/ g.yon pa drug gis des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa'i dang po gnyis kyis yum sangs rgyas spyan ma sku mdog dkar mo sogs/ rnam snang 'khor lo sdom pa'i rnam par badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ

yang slob mas/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor lha tshogs sogs gsol gdab/ dkyil 'khor gtso bo'i phyag g.yas spyi bor bzhag cing g.yon mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya dang bcas te/ rdor dril spyi bor bsnol la/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ming gi dbang*// de ring khyod la bskur bar bya// sangs rgyas mchog tu rab bsgrub phyir// rdo rje'i ming ni khyod kyis zungs/ 'dir me tog gang la thog pa'i rigs so so'i ming btags dgos par gsungs kyang spyi tsam du/ oṃ shrī he ru ka na maḥ.a dhi pa ti staṃ a bhī ṣiñtsa hūm̐ mi bskyod rdo rje zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'o// he ru ka dpal sogs chu dbang bskur/ rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan par gyur/ ār+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ de ltar rnam par snang mdzad ming gi dbang thob// gzugs kyi phung po dang nyon mongs pa gti mug dag /rnam par snang mdzad kyi bskyed rim bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes mngon du 'gyur ba'i skal pa can tu byas pa yin no// drug pa brtul zhugs rdo rje sems dpa'i dbang ni/ slob ma bsang sbyang*/ (359)slob ma dang rdo rje gnyis ka mi dmigs te stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ pam̐ las pad+ma a a las zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du hūm̐ hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las sogs/ rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ zhabs gnyis rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i pang na/ yum rdo rje snyems ma dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud cing*/ zhabs gnyis pad+ma'i skyil krung gis yab kyi sku la 'khril ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan du mas mdzes pa/ de'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ hūm̐ las 'od 'phros dkyil 'khor gtso bo'i thugs ka nas rang 'dra'i ye shes pa dang*/

phyogs bcu'i mchod 'os thams cad rdo rje sems dpa'i rnam par badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thams cad= spyi bor 'khyil pa rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum du gyur nas dbu brgyan par gyur/ ār+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ dbang rdzas kyi rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum snyoms par zhugs te 'od du zhu ba las sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs ye shes las byung ba'i rdo rjer gyur/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bo ste// rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag na gnas// khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bzung*// lag na rdo rje'i brtul zhugs brtan// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ e ṣa dha ra yā mi hi hi hi hi hūm̐/ zhes rdo rje snying gar bcang*/ zhes sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bo rdo rje rtse lnga pa byin pas snying gar rdo rje sems dpa' gsal bar bsam/ ār+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ de ltar rdo rje sems dpa'i dbang thob 'khor ba'i rang bzhin myang 'das su rtogs/ dman par 'dzin pa'i dri ma dag /rdo rje sems dpa'i bskyed rim bsgom pa la dbang*// 'bras bu nyon mongs (360)pa lnga ye shes lnga mngon du gyur pa'i skal pa can du byas pa yin no// bdun pa mnga' dbul ba la sa bcad bcu gnyis su yod pa'i dang po slob ma lhar bskyed pa ni/ bsang sbyang*/ slob ma mi dmigs te stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma ram̐ las nyi ma bam̐ las 'jigs byed dus mtshan gyi steng du khyed rang rnams kyi rnam shes hūm̐ las bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo sdom pa yab yum gyi skur grub cing gsal ba ni sku mdog mthing nag zhal bzhi las zhes pa nas/ yab yum gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par gyur/ bar sgrub thabs ltar dang*/ bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs kar oṃ ha las sogs/ rdo rje phag mo'i lte bar

sogs/ spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon pos mtshan par gyur/ spro na ye shes dbab pa gong ltar bya/ slob mas gsol ba gdab pa ni/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thams cad kyis/ bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ lan gsum/ lha tshogs rnams kyis gsung par bsams la/ rnam bum lag tu thogs/ he ru ka dpal sogs bum dbang ltar la/ rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum gyis dbur brgyan par gyur/ dang po'i lcang lo'i dbang ni/ khyed rang rnams yi dam gyi lhar gsal ba de la lcang lo spyi bor bcings pa'i mos pa mdzod// skra grol nyon mongs grol ba ste// mu tig rgyan ldan yid 'phrog pa// lcang lo cod pan thor tshugs ni// ye shes sgron me'i rgyan du khyer// lcang lo spyi bor bcing tshul bya// gnyis pa byugs pa'i rtsi gsum gyi dbang ni/ khyed rang rnams kyi mkhur rtse gnyis// og ma'i rtse sna'i rtse rnams su khrag gi thig le/ lkog ma'i mgo brang rnams la zhag gi zo ris/ 'gram pa gnyis/ rna ltag gnyis dpral ba sogs lus bying la thal chen gyi tshom bu byugs pa'i mos pa mdzod// khrag ris dmar po snying rje'i rgyan// zhag gi zo ris byams pa'i rgyan// thal chen tshom bu stong nyid rgyan// snang stong dbyer med rgyan du khyer//

thal raka zhag gsum (361)byugs/ gsum pa 'dogs rgyan gsum gyi dbang ni/ dbu la mi mgo skam po lnga// lus la thod rlon khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal/ yan lag bzhi la sbrul gyi gdu bus brgyan pa'i mos pa mdzod// rus rgyan sbrul gyi chun po dang*// thod skam lnga yi dbu rgyan dang*// khrag 'dzag lnga bcu'i do shal rnams// deng nas khyod kyis rgyan du khyer// bzhi pa bgo ba'i gos rnams kyi dbang ni/ sku stod la glang chen gyi ko rlon/ sku smad la stag lpags kyi sham thabs/ sku sked la zhing chen gyi g.yang gzhis g.yogs pa'i mos pa mdzod// 'dod chags dag pa'i g.yang gzhi dang*// zhe sdang dag pa'i stag sham dang*// gti mug dag pa'i glang lpags te// bla med na bza' rgyan du khyer/ lnga pa gdan gyi dbang ni/ pad+ma nyi ma ro'i gdan rkyang 'og tu bting ba'i mos pa mdzod// 'jigs rung dur khrod dbus su ni// he ru ka yi nyams ldan pas// rtog med ro gdan la 'dug ste// nyam nga med pa'i spyod pa gyis/ drug pa thabs shes phyag rgya'i dbang ni/ phyag g.yas su rdo rje dang g.yon du dril bu gtad byung ba'i mos pa mdzod// rdo rje thabs ldan bde ba ste// dril bu shes rab stong pa nyid// thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa'i// rdo rje dril bu bzung bar bya/ bdun pa gri thod kyi dbang ni/ yang gri gug dang thod pa sprad pa thugs ka'i stong 'og tu 'dzin tshul mdzod// g.yas kyi sdig can srog gcod gris// bdud bzhi la sogs srog bcad nas// g.yon gyi ye shes ka pā lar// bdud rtsi lnga la rol par bya/ brgyad pa ni/ phyag g.yas la cang te'u dang g.yon gru mor kha ṭ+wāṃ ga gtad par mos la/ he ru ka dpal kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /rnal 'byor ma dpal ḍā ma ru// dpa' bo dpa' mo gnyis med pa'i// kha ṭ+wāṃ cang te'u bzung bar bya/ dgu pa ni/ thod rnga dang mi rkang gling bu gtad pa 'bud dkrol mdzod cig

/thod pa ltag sprod rnga chung dang*// mkha' 'gro 'bod pa'i gling bu 'di// dam can spyan 'dren mchod pa dang*// phrin las rnam bzhi sgrub (362)phyir zungs/ bcu pa mchod pa ni/ mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod rdzas du mas khyed rang rnams la mchod pa byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ bha ga wān shrī he ru ka tsakra sam+ba raṃ wī ra yo gi nī badz+ra ār+ghaṃ nas shab+da 'i bar gyis rol mo dang bcas te mchod/ bcu gcig pa bstod pa ni/ mchod pa'i lha mo de dag gis bstod par mos/ oṃ/ bcom ldan mgon po sogs rkang brgyad kyis bstod/ brgyad pa dbang don ngo sprad pa ni/ de ltar bum pa'i dbang thob pas/ sbyang gzhi lus lha la sbyang bya dman par 'dzin pa'i dri ma sbyangs shing*/ sbyong byed bskyed rim bsgom pa la dbang*/ sbyangs 'bras mchog gi sprul sku thob par 'gyur ro// zhes dbang don gyi rtogs pa bskyed/ gnyis pa gsang dbang la gsum gyi dang po maṇ+ḍal ni/ ngag tha snyad sna tshogs kyi maṇ+ḍal la// brjod du med pa'i chag chag btab// brjod bya mtshon byed kyi me tog bkod// pha bla ma rnams kyi gsung la 'bul// gsung la phul ba'i bsod nams kyis// bdag gzhan ngag gi sgrib pa byang gyur cig /bdag gzhan ngag la yon tan rdzogs pa dang*// bdag gzhan ngag gis 'gro don 'grub par shog / ces maṇ+ḍal sngon du 'gro bas gsol ba gdab pa ni/ he ru ka dpal 'gro ba'i mgon// bka' drin mnyam med rje btsun gyis// bla med gsang ba'i dbang gis kyang*// bdag cag smin par mdzad du gsol/ lan gsum/ dbang dngos ni/ bla ma dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo yab yum du gsal ba sbyor ba mdzad pa'i sbyor mtshams nas/ byang sems dkar dmar ā li kā li'i rnam par nar gyis byon/ khyed rang rnams kyi lce thog tu myangs bas rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi la sogs pa'i rtsa sbubs mer gyis gang bas/ lus phyi gsal nang gsal thogs pa med par

bsams la/ bdud rtsi sbyin zhing*/ 'khor lo sdom pa yab yum gyi// gsang ba sku yi dkyil 'khor las// byung ba'i byang sems dkar dmar gyis// skal ldan khyod la dbang bskur ro// oṃ badz+ra gu h+ya a bhī ṣañtsa hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing bdud rtsi lce thog tu blang*/ gsum (363) pa dbang don ngo sprad pa ni/ de ltar gsang ba'i dbang thob pas/ sbyang gzhi ngag sngags la sbyang bya dman par 'dzin pa'i dri ma sbyangs shing sbyong byed gtum mo bsgom pa la dbang*/ sbyangs 'bras chos thams cad brag cha ltar stong par rtogs pas chos sku thob par 'gyur ro// zhes dbang don gyi rtogs pa bskyed/ gsum pa sher dbang la gsum gyi dang po/ yid rtog pa sna tshogs kyi maṇ+ḍal la// spros dang bral ba'i chag chag btab// rang byung lhan skyes kyi me tog bkod// pha bla ma rnams kyi thugs la 'bul// thugs la phul ba'i bsod nams kyis// bdag gzhan yid kyi sgrib pa dag gyur cig /bdag gzhan yid la yon tan rdzogs pa dang*// bdag gzhan yid kyis 'gro don 'grub par shog / ces maṇ+ḍal sngon du 'gro bas gsol ba gdab pa ni/ zag med bde chen la gnas pa'i// bcom ldan he ru ka dpal gyis// bde chen lhan skyes dbang gis kyang*// bdag cag smin par mdzad du gsol// gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni thog mar don dri ba la/ gsang sngags bla med don rig pas// zas la dme gtsang med pa dang*// 'khor 'das gnyis su mi rtog pa'i// dam tshig bdag gis bsrung nus sam/ zhes dris pa'i lan btab pa ni/ gsang sngags bla med don rig pas// zas la dme gtsang med pa dang*// 'khor 'das gnyis su mi rtog pa'i// dam tshig bdag gis bsrung nus so// zhes brjod/ bla ma'i thugs ka nas rje btsun ma mar me gcig las gnyis mched kyi tshul du byon te khyed rang rnams la gnang zhing*/ de dang mnyam par sbyar ba tsam gyis dga' bzhi'i bde bas sems 'od gsal du thim pa'i mos pa dang*/
