thur sel yang cung zad 'then la dga' ba ngos bzung gyis shig / kha ṭ+wāṃ ga yum du gsal ba lag tu gtad nas/ srid pa'i 'dod chags spangs nas ni// 'khor ba'i mtsho las sgrol ba'i thabs// zag med dga' bzhi'i dpal skyed pa'i// ye shes lha mo 'di bzhes shig /oṃ ma hā dz+wa la pra dz+nyā (364)dz+nyā na a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ de dang snyoms par zhugs pas dga' ba bzhi'i ye shes mngon du byas par bsams la kha ṭ+wāṃ ga'am rig tsag bzung ngo*// gsum pa dbang don ngo sprad pa ni/ de ltar shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob pas/ sbyang gzhi sems kyi 'char sgo snang stong zung 'jug la/ sbyang bya tha dad gnyis su 'dzin pa'i dri ma sbyangs shing sbyong byed pho nya bsgom pa la dbang*/ sbyangs 'bras zung 'jug longs sku thob par 'gyur ro// zhes dbang don gyi rtogs pa bskyed/ bzhi pa tshig dbang la gsum gyi dang po/ sgo gsum rnam dag gi maṇ+ḍal la// blo dang bral ba'i chag chag btab// sku gsum lhun grub kyi me tog bkod// pha bla ma rnams kyi sku gsung thugs la 'dul// sku gsung thugs la phul ba'i bsod nams kyis// bdag gzhan lus ngag yid gsum sgrib pa byang gyur cig /bdag gzhan lus ngag yid la yon tan rdzogs pa dang*// bdag gzhan lus ngag yid kyis 'gro don 'grub par shog / ces maṇ+ḍal sngon du 'gro bas gsol ba gdab pa ni/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la// mchod sbyin ji ltar stsal ba ltar// bdag kyang bskyab pa'i don slad du// nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol/ lan gsum/ de nas dbang dngos ni/ khyed rang rnams lus rnam snang gi chos bdun dang ldan zhing*/ ngag mi sma dbugs thad sor rgyur 'jug /sems bzang ngan gyi 'dzin rtog spangs la ci gnas kyi bar la mnyam par bzhag mdzod/ cung zad bzhag /bla mas/ slob ma 'di rnams kyis don dam pa'i bden pa mthong bar gyur cig / ces smon lam bya/ de nas bla mas/ bu/

de bzhin nyid kyi ye shes ni// mchog tu mi 'gyur bde bas gang*// bde mchog 'khor lo bde ba'i mchog /de ni rang gi sems nyid yin// ltos shig rang gi sems la ltos// rang gi sems la bltas pas na// dbang bskur la sogs snang ba rnams// gdod nas rang gi sems su gsal// gsal tsam nyid nas stong pa ste// stong pa nyid rang gsal ba'i (365)phyir// snang stong zung 'jug sems kyi don// smra bsam brjod med shes par gyis/ zhes brjod cing don bsam/ gsum pa rjes dbang don ngo sprad pa ni/ de ltar tshig dbang thob pas sbyang gzhi sgo gsum dbyer med 'das brjod bral la/ sbyang bya rtag 'dzin smra brjod kyi dri ma sbyangs shing*/ sbyong byed blo 'das phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa la dbang*/ sbyangs 'bras ngo bo nyid sku thob par 'gyur ro// zhes dbang don gyi rtogs pa bskyed/ gnyis pa mtha' rten la bzhi/ rjes gnang*/ lung bstan/ dbugs dbyung*/ gzengs bstod rnams so// dang po rjes gnang la rnam grangs bcu gnyis yod pa las/ dang por brgyud pa yid bzhin nor bu'i rjes gnang byin par mos shig / nor bu spyi bor bzhag la/ sprul sku bla ma yid bzhin gyi// nor bu rin chen gtsug gi rgyan// rdo rje 'chang dang dbyer med pas// bka' brgyud bla ma'i brgyud pa zungs// gnyis pa smin lam yid bzhin nor bu'i rjes gnang byin par mos shig / rnam rgyal bum pa lag tu gtad la/ mkhyen brtses 'gro ba rjes bzung phyir// dkyil 'khor cho ga bzhin bris nas// dbang bzhi'i skal ldan gdul bya rnams// smin byed las la brtson par gyis/ gsum pa grol lam yid bzhin nor bu'i rjes gnang byin par mos shig / ral gri lag tu gtad la/ 'gro kun 'khor bar 'ching byed pa'i// ma rig zhags pa ji snyed pa// shes rab ral gris bcad nas kyang*// rnam grol lam la 'god par gyis// bzhi pa bzlas pa'i rjes gnang ni// slob dpon dang slob ma gnyis ka lhar gsal ba'i thugs kar pad nyi'i steng du hūm̐ sngon po re re bsam/

bla ma'i thugs kar hūm̐ yig sngags phreng gis bskor ba de las sngags phreng 'phros/ khyed rang rnams kyi khar zhugs snying ga'i hūm̐ gi mthar 'khod pa'i dmigs pa mdzod la 'di'i rjes zlos/ bcom ldan bdag gi bzung lags kyi// bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod la snying po yongs rdzogs rjes zlos byar gzhug /mthar bgrang phreng gtad (366) la/ rin chen thod pa'i bgrang phreng 'di// he ru ka dpal 'khor bcas kyi// mkhyen brtse ye shes thugs rgyud ni// snying po sngags kyis bskul bar gyis// bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod la me tog 'thor/ lnga pa mchod pa'i rjes su gnang ba ni/ stong gsum mchod rdzas kyis bkang ba bla mas dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la 'bul tshul byas la sngags dang phyag rgya lan gcig mdzad par zhu/ las rdor gyis mchod pa btegs/ oṃ gu ru bha ga wān shrī he ru ka tsakra saṃ pa raṃ wī ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra ār+ghaṃ nas/ shab+da 'i bar dang*/ oṃ badz+ra rū pa āḥhūm̐/ shab+da gan+dhe ra sa spar+she āḥhūm̐/ deng nas byang chub ma thob bar// bla ma rgyal ba sras bcas la// phyi nang gsang ba de kho na'i// mchod pa'i las la brtson par gyis// drug pa bstod pa'i rjes gnang byin par mos shig /skal ldan skyes bu khyed rnams kyi// dad gus bsam sbyor gdung dbyangs kyis// bla ma dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la// yon tan sgo nas bstod par bya// bdun pa chos 'chad pa'i rjes gnang byin par mos shig / glegs bam lag tu gtad la/ 'gro rnams smin cing grol bya'i phyir// mdo rgyud bstan bcos man ngag rnams// mtha' drug tshul bzhi'i sgo nas ni// deng nas sna tshogs chos 'khor bskor// brgyad pa rab gnas kyi rjes su gnang bar mos shig / mig thur gtad la/ sku gsung thugs kyi rten rnams la// dbang bskur spyan dbye mnga' dbul sogs// rab tu gnas pa'i bya ba rnams// deng nas khyod kyis yang dag byos// dgu pa sbyin sreg gi rjes gnang byin par mos shig

/ dgang gzar blugs sprad la/ stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pa'i// dgang gzar dgang blugs 'chang ba yis// phyi nang gsang ba de kho na'i// sbyin sreg las la brtson par gyis// bcu pa phrin las bzhi'i rjes gnang byin par mos shig / sna tshogs rdo rje gtad la/ bstan dang 'gro ba'i don du ni// (367)zhi rgyas dbang drag la sogs pa'i// las tshogs rab 'byams rgya mtsho la// khyed rnams dbang bas brtson par gyis/ bcu gcig pa theg dman bdud kyi phyogs gzhom pa'i rjes gnang byin par mos shig / mda' gzhu gtad la/ dpa' bo mi yi seng ge khyod// shes rab snying rje'i mda' gzhu yis// nyan rang zhi bde'i sems dang ni// bdud phyogs gzhom zhing gzhan don gyis/ bcu gnyis pa 'gro kun 'khor ba las sgrol phyir stong nyid snying rje'i rjes gnang byin par mos shig / dug sbrul dang mi mo'i gzugs bstan la/ sdig pa dug sprul reg mthong 'joms// de phyir ci yang mi bya zhing*// dge ba ma ltar byams pa nyid// de phyir phun sum tshogs par bya/ gnyis pa lung bstan pa ni/ slob dpon shākya thub pa'i cha lugs su bsgyur la mi 'jigs phyag rgya chos gos kyi sna gnyis ri dwags kyi rgyal po seng ge'i rna ba ltar bya/ snying gar bzung*/ g.yas g.yon rdor dril 'dzin cing*/ slob dpon ston pa shākya'i rgyal por gyur pas mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya snying gar bzung ba ni/ ri dwags kyi rgyal po seng ge de ri dwags phal pa gang la'ang 'jigs pa med pa ltar/ khyed rnams kyang dkyil 'khor 'dir dbang bskur bas phyis nas nyam nga dang bag tsha ba byed mi dgos pas/ de'i brda chos mtshon bzhin bla ma dang dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thams cad kyis so so'i gsang mtshan dang mthun par 'tshang rgya ba'i lung ston par gyur/ oṃ/ 'di ltar khyod la ngas lung bstan// rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs// srid pa gdod nas dag pa'i phyir// spang bya kun las grol ba yi// khams gsum chos kyi rgyal srid mchog

/kye/ dpal so so'i gsang mtshan brjod la 'di zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs par 'gyur ro// shrī he ru ka gsang mtshan 'di zhes bya ba sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ bhur+bhu wā swā/ zhes brjod/ gsum pa dbugs dbyung ba ni/ bla ma dkyil 'khor pa'i lha tshogs rnams kyis khyed (368)rang rnams la dbugs dbyung stsol bar mos shig /gsang chen mchog gi dkyil 'khor 'dir// dbang bskur zab mo thob pas ni// khams gsum chos kyi rgyal srid che// dpal ldan yon tan 'byung ba'i gnas// bdud tshogs kun las nges rgyal ba'i// grong khyer mchog tu gzhug pa yin/ bzhi pa gzengs bstod pa ni/ slar yang gzengs bstod stsol bar mos// mchog tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir// bcug pa dang ni mthong ba yis// sdig to'i chos las rnam par grol// de phyir khyed rnams bde bar gnas// phyis nas nyam nga dang bral ba'i// bde chen theg pa 'di yis ni// mi thub pa dang mi chod pa// gcig kyang med pas dga' bar gyis// zhes brjod/ gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba ni/ dam tshig bsrung dgos par gdams pa/

gtso bos ji ltar sogs dang bdag gis sgo gsum longs spyod bcas// deng nas 'dren pa khyed la 'bul// nyes ltung dri mas gos gyur na// cha yis spyad cing skyob tu gsol// zhes lan gsum/ gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ dge bsngo byas la slob ma grol lo// rtsa ba'i gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba la/ rtsa ba'i gzhung las sa bcad bcu gcig gis bstan pa'i dang po gtor 'bul ni sgrub thabs kyi gsham nas blangs te 'dir sbyar/ gnyis pa rtsa'i gzhung du tshogs kyi 'khor lo bya bar gsungs kyang deng sang tshogs 'khor dngos nus mkhan gyi rnal 'byor pa dkon bas sa bcad tsam du tshogs mchod 'bul ba ni/ stag lpags la sogs pa'i gdan gyi steng du ma dan dang bā la gtso bor gyur pa'i bza' btung bzang po ci 'byor pa bsham/ bdud rtsi ltar byin brlab/ tshogs zhing spyan 'dren pa ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gnas spyi gtsug nyi zla'i gdan steng na// de na rtsa ba'i bla ma bzhugs// 'khor ni brgyud pa'i bla mas bskor// theg chen chos 'khor de na bskor// bde chen tshogs 'khor 'di na bskor// gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol// gnas 'og min chos kyi pho brang na// de na 'khor lo bde mchog bzhugs// 'khor ni (369)rgyud sde bzhi yis bskor// theg chen chos 'khor de na bskor// bde chen tshogs 'khor 'di na bskor// gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol// gnas dgos 'dod kun 'byung gter gling na// de na ku ru kul+le bzhugs// 'khor ni gnod sbyin mkha' 'gros bskor// theg chen chos 'khor de na bskor// bde chen tshogs 'khor 'di na bskor// gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol// gnas bde chen shar lho nub byang na// de na rigs bzhi'i mkha' 'gro bzhugs// dam tshig las kyi mkha' 'gros bskor// theg chen= bde chen= gnas 'dir= gnas bsil ba tshal gyi dur khrod na// de na ma mgon lcam dral bzhugs// 'khor ni dam can rgya mtshos bskor// theg chen=

bde chen= gnas 'dir= gnas phyogs bcu dben pa'i ri khrod na// de na rdo rje mched lcam bzhugs// 'khor ni skal ldan pho mos bskor// theg chen= bde chen= gnas 'dir= gnas rang lus rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor na// de na rang byung ye shes bzhugs// 'khor ni sems byung tshogs kyis bskor// theg chen= bde chen= gnas 'dir= gshegs nas bde chen tshogs la rol// byin gyis rlobs la dngos grub stsol// phrin las ma lus bsgrub tu gsol// gu ru de ba ḍā ki nī dharma pā la sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ma hā su kha ga ṇa pū dzaḥhoḥ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang*// chos skyong srung ma rdo rje spun// mchod pa'i yul du spyan drangs pas// dgyes bzhin gnang ste byon pa yis// tshogs gnyis spel mdzad thams cad kyang*// nyams dang rtogs pa 'u ru ru// thugs rje'i sprin tshogs thibs se thib// byin rlabs na bun thu lu lu// dngos grub char rgyun 'bebs bzhin du// gnas mchog 'di ru bzhugs su gsol// bzhugs nas bde chen tshogs la rol// tshogs la rol la dgyes bzhin du// rig 'dzin bdag cag (370)'khor bcas la// sku gsung thugs kyi dbang bskur stsol// mos pa'i bu la byin gyis rlobs// bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad sol// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol// rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub par mdzod// gu ru maṇ+ḍa la de wa ḍā ki nī sa pa ri wā ra ma hā su kha ga ṇa pū dza hoḥ zhes slob dpon gyis bdud rtsi 'thor/ yan lag bdun pa 'bul ba ni/ thal mo sbyar te/ bla ma yi dam lha tshogs la// sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// phyi nang gsang gsum mchod pa 'bul// dug gsum dbang gi sdig pa bshags// dus gsum dge la rjes yi rang*// theg gsum chos 'khor bskor bzhin du// khams gsum 'gro ba'i don bzhugs gsol// dge bas sku gsum myur thob shog / ces brjod/

rdo rje'i glu blang ba ni/ kol+la i r+ṭeṭha a bol+la/ mum+mu ṇi re kak+kā+o la// gha ṇa i ki pi ṭa ho badz+dza i// ka ru ṇe ka a i ṇa ro lā// ta hiṃ bā la khādz+dza i// gā ḍeṃ ma a ṇā bidz+dza a i// ha le kā liñdza ra ba ṇi a i// dun+du ra ta hiṃ padz+dza a i// tsa u sa ma kas+thu ri si h+lā// kaspu ra lā i a i// ma lā i in+dha ṇa sā liṃ dza a i// ta hiṃ bha ru khā i a i// phreṅkha ṇa ṣe ṭa ka ran+te// shud+dha a shud+dhaṇ+ṇa ma ṇa a i// ni raṃ shu aṅge tsa ḍā bi a i// ta hiṃ dza sa rā wa ap+pa pa ṇi a i// ma la a dze kun+du ru bā ḍā i// ḍiṇ+ḍi ma ta heṃ ṇa badz+dza a i/ de nas tshogs phud 'bul ba ni// slob dpon gyis bdud rtsi 'thor la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bla med mchog gi mchod pa dam pa 'di/ sogs dkyil chog ltar 'bul/ lugs 'dir dam tshig bsre bar gsungs pa'i tshogs la rol pa ni/ las rdor gyis tshogs bdud rtsi thogs/ kye/ rdo rje slob dpon dgongs su gsol// 'dir ni chos rnams bzang po ste// 'dus pa rnams la the tshom med/ bram ze khyi dang gdol pa phag /rang bzhin gcig tu dgongs te rol/ slob dpon gyis pad kor bcas blangs la/ /rin thang med las legs 'ong chos// 'dod chags la sogs dri ma bral// (371)gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam spangs pas// de bzhin nyid la bdag phyag 'tshal/ a la la hoḥ zhes blang*/ mched lcam rnams la'ang drangs te tshim pa drug ldan tu rol/ de nas gsum pa skong bshags dang 'dod don gsol gdab bya ba ni/ hūm̐/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang*// chos skyong srung ma rdo rje spun// tshogs zhing dam pa 'khor bcas rnams// brtse bas bdag la dgongs su gsol// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas rnams// nyon mongs dug lnga'i dbang gyur bas// 'dod log tshe 'di'i bya ba yis// sgo gsum nyin mtshan kun yengs nas// phyi nang gsang ba mthar thug gi /bsnyen sgrub bzlas brjod tshogs gtor rnams// chag dang chung dang nyams la sogs// sku gsung thugs dang 'gal ba yi// rtsa ba dang ni yan lag gi

/dam tshig nyams chag nyes ltung ni// 'khor ba ngan song rgyur gyur cing*// mtho ris thar pa'i gegs gyur rnams// gnod 'gyod drag po'i sems kyis ni// ma lus bdag gis mthol lo bshags// slan chad sdom zhing dag par bgyid// brtse bas byin gyis rlabs tu gsol// dngos 'byor yid kyis sprul pa yi// phyi nang gsang ba mthar thug gi /'dod yon rnam lnga'i mchod sprin ni// bkod pa mchog gyur kun tshang zhing*// sa dang bar snang khyab pa yis// bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang*// chos skyong srung ma rdo rje spun// 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyi// thugs bzhed rnam dag 'grub gyur cig /thugs bsam rnam dag rdzogs gyur cig /thugs dam gnyan po bskangs gyur cig /thugs dam gnyan po skong gyur nas// mkhyen brtse mthu stobs nus pa dang*// rdzu 'phrul drag shul rgyas gyur cig /khyed kyi thugs dam bskangs gyur nas// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi// dam tshig nyams chags bskang du gsol// dam tshig nyams chags bskangs nas kyang*// brtse ba chen pos rjes bzung phyir// 'gyur med sku yi dngos (372)grub stsol// tshangs dbyangs gsung gi= 'khrul med thugs kyi= yon tan re skor= phrin las 'gro 'dul dngos grub stsol// mdor na mchog dang thun mong ga /dngos grub ma lus khyed kyis stsol// sngon las 'phral rkyen la sogs pa'i// bar chad ma lus khyed kyis sol// deng nas byang chub ma thob bar// blo 'gel ltos skyur re sa dang*// skyabs gnas gzhan na ma mchis pas// mkhyen brtse nus ldan khyed rnams kyis// bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams// brtse bas 'bral med bskyang du gsol// bzhi pa lhag ma btang ba ni/ las rdor gyis lhag ma rnams bsdus te slob dpon mdun du bzhag pa la/ slob dpon gyis bya khyung gi phyag rgya dang*/ ma da nas kha phru btab la/ oṃ uts+tshiṣ+ṭa ba liṃ ta bhak+ṣa sī swā hā/

oṃ brjod pas lhag gtor mi dmigs te stong par bsam/ āḥbarjod pas thod pa la sogs pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba du mar bsam/ hūm̐ brjod pas de thams cad kyi nang du zad mi shes pa'i 'dod yon lnga/ ngo bo bzang zhing rgya che bas yid la zag pa med pa'i bde ba skyed nus pa/ rnam pa'i bkod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas dbang po lnga tshims nus par gyur/ lhag ma mtshams stegs la bkod/ rdor thal phye bas/ oṃ dz+nyā na ḍā ki nī/ sa ma ya ḍā ki nī/ lo ka ḍā kī nī/ sa pa ri wā ra ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi/ lan gsum/ nam mkha' mdzod dang*/ a kā ro rnams kyang brjod/ hūm̐/ dang po phud kyis mi mchod du// bla ma yi dam phud kyi bdag /bar du tshogs la mi rol du// mkha' 'gro chos skyong tshogs la mnyes// de tshe 'dod yon mi spyod du// rnal 'byor pho mo 'dod pas tshim// lhag ma khyod la mi ster du// khyed rnams nga yi bran dang g.yog /lhag ma kha phru mi btab tu// rje dang 'bangs su khyad bar che// tha mar gcig tu mi bsre ru// chos nyid ngang du khyad par med// da lan rnal 'byor pho mo yi// 'dod yon tshogs la rol pa'i lhag /sna tshogs 'dod pa'i (373)gtor ma 'di// rang rang 'dod pa'i snod du blugs// byams pa chen po'i kha phru btab// snying rje chen po'i sngags bzlas nas// gzhan don dga' spro'i phyag rgya bstan// srid zhi mnyam nyid ting 'dzin gyis// 'dod rgu 'byung bar byin brlabs pa'i// dpal gyi gtor ma 'di longs shig /blangs nas rol zhing tshims gyis la// he ru ka yi bka' bzhin du// bcol ba'i phrin las thams cad sgrubs// sa ma ya ma nu sma ra/ sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu/ lnga pa gtor ma btang ba ni/ chos skyong spyi gtor bran la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bh+rūm̐ oṃ dz+riṃ kham̐ hūm̐ rnams 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i drag po'i mchod yon dang nyer spyod/ rgyal srid sna bdun/ mkha' lding dang seng ge la sogs pa'i rkang bzhi'i tshogs dang*/

mtshon cha dang dur khrod kyi yo byad sogs dam can rgya mtsho mnyes pa'i mchod sprin sa dang nam mkha' bar snang thams cad khyab par bsams la/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā ār+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du/ dhū pe= a lo ke= gan+dhe= nai wi d+ya= shab+da 'i bar kyis sngags rol mo dang bcas pas byin gyis brlab/ hūm̐/ khrag 'thung rgyal po he ru ka lha chen nag po dpal 'bar dang*/ bh+yoḥ lha mo nag mo re mā ti// mkha' 'gro me lce 'bar ma gnyis// bka' nyan 'khor gyis bskor ba ni// 'jig rten gsum gyi dregs pa'i gtso// lha chen brgyad dang klu chen brgyad// gza' chen brgyad dang 'jigs byed dgu// rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang*// phyogs skyong bcu dang rgyal chen bzhi// bsil ba tshal la sogs pa yi// dur khrod rnams kyi bdag po dang*// nā lan+da la sogs pa yi// gtsug lag khang gi srung ma dang*// lha srin sde brgyad dregs pa can// rgyan dang cha lugs bzhon par bcas// sprul pa yang sprul nyid sprul dang*// 'khor 'bangs bran g.yog ma lus pa// 'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs su gsol// brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes shig /dmar chen gtor (374)ma 'di bzhes shig /rak+ta'i mchod yon= dbang po'i me tog= sha chen bdug spos= zhun chen snang gsal= bdud rtsi'i dri chab= sha khrag zhal zas= rkang gling rol mo= bdud rtsi sman raka= dza gad phud mchod= dpa' bo'i ngar chu= sngar bcol gtang rag= phyi ma'i zhu gsol 'di bzhes shig /bla med mchod pa 'di bzhes nas// mkha' mnyam sems can thams cad la// phan bde ma lus 'byung ba'i gnas// sangs rgyas bstan pa rin po che// phyogs dus gnas skabs thams cad du// dar rgyas yun ring gnas pa dang*// 'gro la bde skyid 'byung ba yi// phrin las g.yel med mdzad du gsol// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi// chos ldan bsam sbyor kun 'grub cing*// re ba thams cad bskang du gsol// bsam pa thams cad bsgrub tu gsol//

zhes gtor ma 'bul/ badz+ra muḥ gtor mgron ye shes pa rnams gshegs/ drug pa gtang rag gi mchod pa ni/ mchod pa kha gsos la bsang sbyang*/ sgrub thabs ltar byin brlab/ rab 'byams zhing gi dkyil 'khor sogs 'dod yon lnga mchod dkyil chog ltar 'bul/ hūm̐/ bcom ldan mgon po sogs rkang brgyad kyis bstod/ bdun pa dbang bzhi blang ba ni/ dpal ldan bla ma rin po che// sku gsung thugs las byung ba yi// bdag la dbang bzhi bskur du gsol// smin cing grol bar mdzad du gsol// bla ma'i sku la gsol ba 'debs// lus la bde drod 'bar bar byin gyis rlobs// bla ma'i gsung la gsol= ngag la nus pa thon par= bla ma'i thugs la gsol= sems la rtogs pa 'char bar= bla ma'i sku gsung thugs la gsol ba 'debs// sgo gsum dbyer med rtogs par byin gyis rlobs// zhes gsol ba btab pas/ bla ma dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thams cad kyi spyi bo'i oṃ dkar po las 'od zer dkar po'i tshogs dpag tu med pa 'phros/ bdag dang (375)sems can thams cad kyi spyi bor thim/ sku las kyang sku dpag tu med pa 'phros/ lus la thim pas skye ba dang tshe rabs thams cad du lus kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par byas/ sku bum pa'i dbang thob/ lus sku rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur/ lam bskyed rim bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu sprul sku thob pa'i skal ldan du gyur/ yang bla ma dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thams cad kyi mgrin pa'i āḥdamar po las 'od zer dmar po'i tshogs dpag tu med pa 'phros/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi mgrin par thim/ zhal nas kyang ā li kā li la sogs te sngags kyi phreng ba dpag tu med pa 'phros/ lce la thim pas skye ba dang tshe rabs thams cad du ngag gi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par byas/

gsung gsang ba'i dbang thob/ ngag gsung rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur/ lam gtum mo bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu chos sku thob pa'i skal ldan du gyur/ yang bla ma dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thams cad kyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ sngon po las 'od zer sngon po'i tshogs dpag tu med pa 'phros/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi snying gar thim/ yang rdo rje dril bu gri gug thod pa ḍa ma ru kha ṭ+wāṃ ga la sogs te phyag mtshan dpag tu med pa 'phros/ snying gar thim pas skye ba dang tshe rabs thams cad du yid kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par byas/ thugs shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ yid thugs rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur/ lam pho nya bsgoms la dbang*/ 'bras bu longs sku thob pa'i skal ldan du gyur/ de nas bla ma dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thams cad kyi spyi mgrin snying ga'i gnas gsum la thim pas skye ba dang tshe rabs thams cad du sgo gsum gcig char du bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri (376)ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par byas/ dbang bzhi pa tshig dbang rin po che thob/ sgo gsum sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur/ lam phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku thob pa'i skal ldan du gyur par

bsam mo// brgyad pa bzod par gsol ba ni/ oṃ badz+ra he ru ka sa ma ya sogs/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*// gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni// bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal ba// de kun mgon pos bzod par gsol// lhag pa dang ni chad pa dang*// cho ga'i yan lag nyams pa dang*// bdag gis bgyis nongs ci mchis pa// de yang mgon pos bzod par gsol// bag med brjod pa ma dag pa// rgyud las gsungs pa'i cho ga bzhin// ma lcogs 'khrul pa ci mchis pa// de yang mgon pos bzod par gsol// zhes nongs pa bshags/ dgu pa nyer bsdu ni/ dkyil 'khor ras bris skabs/ ye shes pa rnams rten 'di nyid la 'byung ba bzhis gnod pas ma zhig gi bar du brtan par bzhugs nas bstan pa dang sems can gyi don mdzad du gsol/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+rā ya swā hā/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor 'od du zhu nas rang la thim par gyur/ bcu pa bsngo ba ni/ bdag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis nye bar mtshon te bdag dang 'khor 'das sems can thams cad kyi dus gsum du bsags pa dang yod pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba la brten nas bdag gzhan nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las zhing khams gdul bya sku tshe mdzad pa sogs da lta nyid du mnyam par gyur nas chos kyi dbyings nam mkha'i mthar thug gi sems can thams cad 'khor ba dong nas ma sprugs kyi bar du 'bad rtsol dang thogs thug med par 'gro ba'i don rgyun chad med pa 'byung bar gyur cig /sangs rgyas sku bzhi brnyes pa'i byin rlabs dang*/ sogs sh+lo ka brjod/ bcu gcig pa shis brjod bya ba ni/ me (377 )tog 'thor la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ sku gsum mngon gyur rdo rje 'chang*// bde gsal mi rtog ngang las ni// khams gsum 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i// bka' brgyud bla ma'i bkra shis shog

/chos dbyings srid zhi'i ngo bo nyid// dkyil 'khor lha yi rnam par shar// dran pas dngos grub gnyis 'byung ba'i// yi dam lha yi= bla med rgyal ba'i 'khril sbyor yum// 'gro kun dge legs sgrub mdzad ma// rnal 'byor nyams rtogs skyed pa'i srid// ma srid mkha' 'gro'i bkra= chos nyid zhi ba'i ngang bzhugs kyang*// bstan dgra sgrol phyir drag shul can// rnal 'byor phrin las kun sgrub pa'i// chos skyong srung ma'i= bla ma'i bka' lung dbang bzhi'i don// yengs med nyams len dam tshig srung*// rang bas bla ma mched lcam gces// rdo rje spun gyi= gdod nas stong pa chos kyi sku// srid zhi gang du'ang ma grub cing*// rang ngo shes pas rang sar grol// ye shes sems kyi= mdor na dam pa khyed rnams kyi// bden pa chen po'i mthu las ni// gnas 'dir dam chos 'phel ba dang*// bde legs phun sum tshogs par shog / ces brjod la bde legs su bya'o// kun las khyad 'phags thun mong ma yin pa'i// grub thob snyan nas brgyud pa'i zab chos 'dis// skal ldan mtha' dag rgyud smin rnam grol mchog /bde chen rtag pa dam pa'i dpal thob shog /ces pa'ang gdams ngag mdzod bka' brgyud rin po che'i khrid rim rnams kyi smin byed du bzhugs su gsol ba dang*/ mkhan chen bla ma rin po che karma bkra shis 'od zer rab tu rgyas pa'i sde'i zhal snga nas gsung bskul gnang ba ltar/ ris med kyi bstan pa la gus pa karma ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtsho phrin las kun khyab dpal bzang pos rtsa ba'i yi ge gtsang smyon he ru ka'i nor bu skor gsum dang mthun par shrī de bī ko ṭi tsā 'dra rin chen brag gi sgrub gnas su rang lo gya bdun par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni nye bar gnas pa blo gsal gsang sngags bstan 'dzin nas bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/// / (378)
